### FEAT-ADAS-07: Automated Parking Assist (APA)
- **Domain:** ADAS & Autonomous Driving | **Target ASIL:** ASIL B
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Assists driver by autonomously executing parallel, perpendicular, and diagonal parking maneuvers with driver supervising inside the cabin.
- **Activation Logic:** Driver seated, seatbelt buckled, vehicle speed <= 30 km/h during slot search, surround ultrasonic and camera sensors operational. Entry: Driver activates 'Park Assist' button; vehicle scans and identifies valid slot; driver selects slot and releases brake.. Deactivation: Driver grabs steering wheel (> 2.5 Nm), driver presses brake firmly, door opened, or obstacle hazard detected in path.. Override: Driver can pause maneuver at any time by holding brake pedal; releasing brake resumes maneuver seamlessly..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-APA-01: Prevent collision with adjacent parked vehicles and curbs; stop within <= 15 cm clearance. | FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Immediate hydraulic brake application; disengage automated steering..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-ADAS-07)

##### `SYS-ADAS-07-01`: Ultrasonic & Vision Parking Space Dimension Measurement [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL measure candidate parking space length and depth with +-5 cm accuracy while driving past at speeds up to 25 km/h, verifying slot is at least 0.8 m longer than vehicle length.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 200 ms | Safe State: Do not offer slot if dimension certainty < 80%.
- **Failure Reaction:** If side ultrasonic sensors blocked by mud, prompt driver to clean sensors.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-07-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-07-01), [`SWR-ADAS-07-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-07-02)

##### `SYS-ADAS-07-02`: Multi-Turn Parking Path Guidance & Gear Shift Automation [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL compute and execute collision-free multi-turn parking paths, automatically controlling steering angle (+-540 deg) and gear changes (D to R) to complete parking in <= 5 turns.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 80 ms | Safe State: Brake to stop; hand over vehicle control to driver.
- **Failure Reaction:** If path blocked by moving pedestrian, hold position until path clears.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-07-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-07-03), [`SWR-ADAS-07-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-07-04)

##### `SYS-ADAS-07-03`: Multi-Move Path Shifting & Automated Transmission Direction Coordinator [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL coordinate automated multi-turn maneuvers (up to 5 gear shifts between DRIVE and REVERSE) to park in tight spaces, holding vehicle with foundation brakes during shift transition (< 800 ms).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 80 ms | Safe State: Hold vehicle stopped in current gear; request driver manual intervention.
- **Failure Reaction:** If shift actuator times out > 1200 ms, abort parking maneuver and apply EPB.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-07-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-07-05), [`SWR-ADAS-07-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-07-06)

##### `SYS-ADAS-07-04`: Remote Smartphone Continuous Touch Dead-Man Switch Supervisor [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL supervise Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) remote smartphone touch input: Vehicle motion SHALL occur ONLY while user continuously holds finger on smartphone screen button, stopping in <= 200 ms upon touch release or BLE disconnect (> 6 m distance).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Execute immediate stop; apply hydraulic service brakes.
- **Failure Reaction:** If BLE packet loss exceeds 2 consecutive packets (100 ms), halt vehicle instantly.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-07-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-07-07), [`SWR-ADAS-07-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-07-08)

##### `SYS-ADAS-07-05`: Ultrasonic Echo Time-of-Flight Slot Width & Depth Profiler [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Measure parking slot dimensions (parallel slot min length = car + 0.8m) at speeds <= 20 km/h.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 40 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-07-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-07-09), [`SWR-ADAS-07-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-07-10)

##### `SYS-ADAS-07-06`: Surround View Camera Parking Line Corner Coordinate Extractor [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Extract parking slot painted boundary lines and corners from 4 fisheye cameras.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-07-11`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-07-11), [`SWR-ADAS-07-12`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-07-12)

##### `SYS-ADAS-07-07`: Collision-Free Multi-Segment Parking Trajectory Planner [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Generate continuous-curvature Reeds-Shepp parking maneuver path with <= 3 direction reversals.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-07-13`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-07-13), [`SWR-ADAS-07-14`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-07-14)

##### `SYS-ADAS-07-08`: Steering Wheel Automated Angle Servocontrol Tracking Law [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Command steering rack angle with tracking error <= 0.3° and maximum angular speed 450 °/s.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-07-15`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-07-15), [`SWR-ADAS-07-16`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-07-16)

##### `SYS-ADAS-07-09`: Slow-Speed Propulsion Torque & Creep Velocity Governor [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Govern vehicle speed precisely to 3.5 +- 0.5 km/h during automated parking maneuver.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 30 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-07-17`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-07-17), [`SWR-ADAS-07-18`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-07-18)

##### `SYS-ADAS-07-10`: Dynamic Ultrasonic Proximity Obstacle Encroachment Monitor [ASIL B] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Monitor obstacle clearance; command immediate stop if distance drops below 25 cm.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-07-19`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-07-19), [`SWR-ADAS-07-20`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-07-20)

##### `SYS-ADAS-07-11`: Driver Steering Wheel Hands-On Intervention Cancellation Gate [ASIL B] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Abort automated parking maneuver immediately if driver applies > 3.0 Nm steering wheel torque.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 30 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-07-21`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-07-21), [`SWR-ADAS-07-22`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-07-22)

##### `SYS-ADAS-07-12`: Automated Shift-by-Wire Reverse/Drive Transition Sequence Manager [ASIL B] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Coordinate smooth vehicle stop, brake apply, and gear change (R <-> D) during multi-point turn.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-07-23`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-07-23), [`SWR-ADAS-07-24`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-07_APA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-07-24)

##### `SYS-ADAS-07-13`: Curbside Wheel Rim Scrape Protection & Tilt Mirror Actuator [ASIL B] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Estimate distance to curb edge and tilt side mirrors down to provide driver visual feedback.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.

- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.

### FEAT-ADAS-08: Blind Spot Detection & Lane Change Assist (BSD-LCA)
- **Domain:** ADAS & Autonomous Driving | **Target ASIL:** ASIL B
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Monitors blind spots and fast-approaching adjacent lane traffic using rear corner radars, issuing mirror alerts and active steering resistance.
- **Activation Logic:** Ignition in RUN, vehicle speed >= 15 km/h, rear radar sensors unblocked. Entry: Vehicle moving forward; adjacent target vehicle detected within blind zone (0-5m) or closing rapidly (TTC <= 3.5s at up to 70m range).. Deactivation: Target passes beyond zone, vehicle speed < 10 km/h, or reverse gear selected.. Override: Driver steering override with torque > 3.0 Nm immediately cancels steering resistance..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-BSD-01: Prevent collision with adjacent lane vehicles during lane changes. | FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Inhibit active steering torque; leave visual mirror icon illuminated as passive warning..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-ADAS-08)

##### `SYS-ADAS-08-01`: Adjacent Lane Approaching Vehicle Closing-Speed Tracking [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL track vehicles in adjacent lanes up to 70 m rearward using dual 77 GHz rear corner radars, calculating Time-to-Collision (TTC <= 3.5s) at >= 20 Hz.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Invalidate target; extinguish warning icon.
- **Failure Reaction:** If radar misaligned (> 2 deg mechanical tilt), trip service icon.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-08-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SwReq.md#swr-adas-08-01), [`SWR-ADAS-08-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SwReq.md#swr-adas-08-02)

##### `SYS-ADAS-08-02`: Side-Mirror HMI Alerts & Active Evasive Steering Resistance [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL illuminate mirror icons when blind zone is occupied, and apply up to 2.5 Nm resistive steering torque if driver activates turn indicator towards occupied lane.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 80 ms | Safe State: Zero steering resistance torque; maintain visual alert.
- **Failure Reaction:** If steering actuator fails to acknowledge, sound loud cabin alarm.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-08-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SwReq.md#swr-adas-08-03), [`SWR-ADAS-08-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SwReq.md#swr-adas-08-04)

##### `SYS-ADAS-08-03`: Side Mirror Dual-Stage LED Warning & Acoustic Chime Trigger [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL command side mirror triangular amber LED indicators: Stage 1 (Continuous ON) when vehicle is in blind zone; Stage 2 (Flashing 4.0 Hz + 800 Hz chime) if driver activates turn indicator towards occupied zone.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 60 ms | Safe State: Extinguish warning LEDs; prompt driver via cluster text.
- **Failure Reaction:** If LED driver reports open circuit, log DTC B15C2 and display cluster alert.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-08-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SwReq.md#swr-adas-08-05), [`SWR-ADAS-08-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SwReq.md#swr-adas-08-06)

##### `SYS-ADAS-08-04`: Active Steering Resistance Overlay to Oppose Collision Lane Change [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL command EPS steering torque resistance (up to +3.0 Nm opposing driver turn) if driver begins steering across lane line into an approaching vehicle (TTC <= 2.5s) to prevent sideswipe collision.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 40 ms | Safe State: Zero opposing torque; restore free manual steering.
- **Failure Reaction:** Inhibit steering resistance if driver applies > 5.0 Nm intentional force.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-08-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SwReq.md#swr-adas-08-07), [`SWR-ADAS-08-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SwReq.md#swr-adas-08-08)

##### `SYS-ADAS-08-05`: Rear Corner Radar High-Speed Object Trajectory Tracker [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Track position, velocity, and heading of up to 32 targets in adjacent lanes up to 75 m rearward.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 40 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-08-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SwReq.md#swr-adas-08-09), [`SWR-ADAS-08-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SwReq.md#swr-adas-08-10)

##### `SYS-ADAS-08-06`: Adjacent Lane Blind Spot Zone Vehicle Occupancy Detector [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Detect presence of vehicles in blind zone polygon (from side mirror to 3 m rear of bumper).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 40 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-08-11`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SwReq.md#swr-adas-08-11), [`SWR-ADAS-08-12`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SwReq.md#swr-adas-08-12)

##### `SYS-ADAS-08-07`: Closing Velocity & Time-to-Collision (TTC) Criticality Evaluator [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Calculate TTC = d_rel / v_closing; trigger Level 1 warning when TTC <= 3.5 seconds.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 30 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-08-13`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SwReq.md#swr-adas-08-13), [`SWR-ADAS-08-14`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SwReq.md#swr-adas-08-14)

##### `SYS-ADAS-08-08`: Side Mirror Optical Warning LED Intensity Driver [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Drive side-mirror amber warning LED, adjusting brightness according to ambient light sensor.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-08-15`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SwReq.md#swr-adas-08-15), [`SWR-ADAS-08-16`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SwReq.md#swr-adas-08-16)

##### `SYS-ADAS-08-09`: Turn Signal Activation Intent & Level 2 Alert Escalation [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Escalate to flashing optical warning and 750 Hz acoustic chime if driver signals toward occupied lane.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-08-17`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SwReq.md#swr-adas-08-17), [`SWR-ADAS-08-18`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SwReq.md#swr-adas-08-18)

##### `SYS-ADAS-08-10`: Active Lane Change Steering Resistance Torque Superposition [ASIL B] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Apply subtle counter-torque (+-1.5 Nm) through EPS if driver begins turning into occupied lane.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-08-19`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SwReq.md#swr-adas-08-19), [`SWR-ADAS-08-20`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SwReq.md#swr-adas-08-20)

##### `SYS-ADAS-08-11`: Motorcycle & Narrow Vulnerable Vehicle High-Sensitivity Classifier [ASIL B] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Enhance radar reflection clustering to identify low-RCS motorcycles overtaking in blind spots.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 40 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-08-21`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SwReq.md#swr-adas-08-21), [`SWR-ADAS-08-22`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SwReq.md#swr-adas-08-22)

- **Statement:** The System SHALL Filter out stationary guardrails, acoustic barriers, and light poles from blind spot trigger alerts.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-08-23`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SwReq.md#swr-adas-08-23), [`SWR-ADAS-08-24`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-08_BSD_SwReq.md#swr-adas-08-24)

### FEAT-ADAS-09: Rear Cross Traffic Alert & Braking (RCTA-RCTB)
- **Domain:** ADAS & Autonomous Driving | **Target ASIL:** ASIL B
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-ADAS-09_RCTA_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-09_RCTA_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-ADAS-09_RCTA_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-09_RCTA_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Detects cross-traffic vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians approaching from the left or right while reversing out of parking spaces, issuing warnings and applying autonomous braking.
- **Activation Logic:** Reverse gear (R) selected, vehicle speed <= 15 km/h, rear radar sensors unblocked. Entry: Target approaching laterally from left/right rear corners with TTC <= 2.5s (alert) or TTC <= 1.0s (braking).. Deactivation: Vehicle shifted out of Reverse, target passes, or vehicle brought to standstill for > 2.0s.. Override: Driver applying hard accelerator press overrides autonomous braking after 1.5s hold..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-RCTA-01: Prevent reversing collisions into lateral crossing traffic; avoid unintended sudden stops without hazard. | FTTI: 80 ms | Safe State: Release autonomous brake request to 0.0 m/s²..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-ADAS-09)

##### `SYS-ADAS-09-01`: Lateral Approaching Cross-Traffic Kinematics Detection [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL detect lateral cross-traffic approaching at speeds from 5 km/h to 35 km/h up to 35 m away using rear corner radars, evaluating lateral Time-to-Collision (TTC) within <= 20 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 60 ms | Safe State: Invalidate cross-traffic tracks; extinguish warning icons.
- **Failure Reaction:** If radar detects stationary parked vehicle as crossing target, filter out via zero Doppler speed.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-09-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-09_RCTA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-09-01), [`SWR-ADAS-09-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-09_RCTA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-09-02)

##### `SYS-ADAS-09-02`: Autonomous Reversing Emergency Deceleration Intervention [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL command autonomous emergency braking (up to -6.0 m/s²) in <= 80 ms if reversing collision is imminent (TTC <= 1.0s), holding the vehicle stopped for 2.0 seconds.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 80 ms | Safe State: Release brake pressure after 2.0s standstill hold.
- **Failure Reaction:** If hydraulic brake actuator fails to respond, engage electronic parking brake (EPB).
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-09-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-09_RCTA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-09-03), [`SWR-ADAS-09-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-09_RCTA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-09-04)

##### `SYS-ADAS-09-03`: Reversing Camera Dynamic Trajectory Overlay & Guidance Bounding Box [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL render dynamic curved trajectory guide lines overlaid on reversing camera video display at 30 fps, highlighting approaching cross-traffic targets with flashing red bounding boxes and directional arrows.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 80 ms | Safe State: Display raw camera video stream without overlay graphics.
- **Failure Reaction:** If graphics overlay processor crashes, display static guidelines from camera firmware.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-09-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-09_RCTA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-09-05), [`SWR-ADAS-09-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-09_RCTA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-09-06)

##### `SYS-ADAS-09-04`: Low-Height Obstacle & Bolted Bollard Proximity Clamper [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL detect low-height stationary obstacles (parking bollards, concrete stops, fire hydrants) behind bumper (< 1.5 m) using 4 rear ultrasonic sensors, automatically braking to prevent vehicle bumper damage.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Clamp brakes; sound continuous parking buzzer tone.
- **Failure Reaction:** Inhibit auto-braking if ultrasonic sensors are covered with snow/ice.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-09-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-09_RCTA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-09-07), [`SWR-ADAS-09-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-09_RCTA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-09-08)

##### `SYS-ADAS-09-05`: Reverse Gear Selection Trigger & System State Initialization [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Arm rear cross traffic monitoring within 100 ms of driver selecting REVERSE gear.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-09-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-09_RCTA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-09-09), [`SWR-ADAS-09-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-09_RCTA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-09-10)

##### `SYS-ADAS-09-06`: Rear Corner Radar 150-Degree Ultra-Wide Crossing Target Scanner [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Scan cross traffic approaching perpendicularly from left and right at speeds from 5 to 40 km/h.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 30 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-09-11`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-09_RCTA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-09-11), [`SWR-ADAS-09-12`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-09_RCTA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-09-12)

##### `SYS-ADAS-09-07`: Crossing Vehicle Lateral Path Intersection & TTC Predictor [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Compute projected collision point behind vehicle; assert warning if TTC <= 2.5 seconds.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 30 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-09-13`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-09_RCTA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-09-13), [`SWR-ADAS-09-14`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-09_RCTA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-09-14)

##### `SYS-ADAS-09-08`: 3-Stage Driver Warning Alert (Visual Graphic, Audio Chime, HUD) [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Display directional red flashing arrows on reverse camera screen and sound directional chimes.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 40 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-09-15`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-09_RCTA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-09-15), [`SWR-ADAS-09-16`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-09_RCTA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-09-16)

##### `SYS-ADAS-09-09`: Rear Cross Traffic Autonomous Braking (RCTB) Trigger Governor [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Command full braking stop (-6.0 m/s²) in <= 120 ms if crossing vehicle TTC drops below 1.2s.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-09-17`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-09_RCTA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-09-17), [`SWR-ADAS-09-18`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-09_RCTA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-09-18)

##### `SYS-ADAS-09-10`: Rear Bumper Ultrasonic Sensor Close-Range Fusion Gatekeeper [ASIL B] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Cross-validate radar detections with rear ultrasonic sensors to confirm close-range obstacles.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 30 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-09-19`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-09_RCTA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-09-19), [`SWR-ADAS-09-20`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-09_RCTA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-09-20)

##### `SYS-ADAS-09-11`: Pedestrian & Cyclist Low-Profile Crossing Target Detector [ASIL B] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Detect walking pedestrians (speed 1-5 km/h) crossing behind vehicle in low-light parking conditions.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 40 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-09-21`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-09_RCTA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-09-21), [`SWR-ADAS-09-22`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-09_RCTA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-09-22)

##### `SYS-ADAS-09-12`: Trailer Hitch Engagement Automatic RCTB Deactivation [ASIL B] [Release: R400]

- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.

### FEAT-ADAS-10: Intelligent Speed Assist & Traffic Sign Recognition (ISA-TSR)
- **Domain:** ADAS & Autonomous Driving | **Target ASIL:** ASIL B
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-ADAS-10_ISA_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-10_ISA_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-ADAS-10_ISA_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-10_ISA_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Recognizes optical traffic signs, fuses with navigation speed limit data, and provides automated speed limit adoption to comply with EU GSR regulations.
- **Activation Logic:** Ignition in RUN, front camera active, navigation map database loaded. Entry: Always active by default at vehicle start (EU GSR mandate); driver can toggle audio overspeed chime.. Deactivation: Autonomous speed limiting disengaged if driver presses throttle kickdown (> 85% travel).. Override: Throttle kickdown immediately overrides speed limiter for passing maneuvers..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-ISA-01: Prevent unexpected severe deceleration due to misrecognized speed signs. | FTTI: 500 ms | Safe State: Revert to baseline driver manual accelerator control; display unconfirmed sign with question mark..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-ADAS-10)

##### `SYS-ADAS-10-01`: Camera Traffic Sign Optical Recognition & Nav Map Fusion [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL detect standard circular and rectangular speed signs (including electronic LED variable message signs) with >= 95% accuracy up to 80 m, fusing detections with GPS digital map speed limits within 100 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 250 ms | Safe State: Display last known confirmed speed limit or null indicator.
- **Failure Reaction:** If sign confidence < 75%, do not post limit to cluster.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-10-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-10_ISA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-10-01), [`SWR-ADAS-10-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-10_ISA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-10-02)

##### `SYS-ADAS-10-02`: Overspeed Visual-Acoustic Alerting & Speed Limiter Interface [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL alert driver within 1.0s if speed exceeds posted limit by > 3 km/h, and clamp powertrain cruise control setpoint to matched limit if Intelligent Speed Limiter mode is active.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 500 ms | Safe State: Release cruise setpoint clamping; silence chime.
- **Failure Reaction:** If speedometer CAN signal missing, disable overspeed alerts.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-10-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-10_ISA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-10-03), [`SWR-ADAS-10-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-10_ISA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-10-04)

##### `SYS-ADAS-10-03`: Electronic Horizon Map Speed Limit Fusion & Conditional Signs [ASIL A] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL fuse optical TSR speed signs with electronic navigation horizon digital map data, correctly resolving conditional speed limits (e.g. 'In Rain', 'Time of Day', 'School Zone', 'Exit 40 km/h') based on vehicle sensors.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 250 ms | Safe State: Default to general road class speed limit.
- **Failure Reaction:** If conditional condition cannot be verified (e.g. rain sensor uncertain), display both limits on cluster.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-10-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-10_ISA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-10-05), [`SWR-ADAS-10-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-10_ISA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-10-06)

##### `SYS-ADAS-10-04`: Autonomous Speed Adaptation & Powertrain Torque Soft-Clamping [ASIL A / EU 2019/2144] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL support driver-selectable Intelligent Speed Limiter mode: Automatically restricting maximum powertrain propulsion torque to prevent vehicle speed from exceeding active posted speed limit + tolerance (+-0 to +5 km/h).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 200 ms | Safe State: Release torque restriction; allow driver 100% standard accelerator pedal control.
- **Failure Reaction:** Driver accelerator kickdown (> 80% pedal travel) immediately overrides limiter.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-10-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-10_ISA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-10-07), [`SWR-ADAS-10-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-10_ISA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-10-08)

##### `SYS-ADAS-10-05`: Front Camera Traffic Sign Deep Learning Detection & Classification [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Detect circular and rectangular regulatory speed limit signs with classification accuracy >= 98%.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-10-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-10_ISA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-10-09), [`SWR-ADAS-10-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-10_ISA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-10-10)

##### `SYS-ADAS-10-06`: Digital Navigation Map Speed Limit Database Fusion Engine [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Fuse visual camera signs with digital map vector speed attributes, resolving conflicting values.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-10-11`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-10_ISA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-10-11), [`SWR-ADAS-10-12`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-10_ISA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-10-12)

##### `SYS-ADAS-10-07`: Electronic Overhead Variable Message Sign (VMS) LED Reader [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Read dynamic LED variable speed signs on overhead highway gantries across varying illumination.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-10-13`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-10_ISA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-10-13), [`SWR-ADAS-10-14`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-10_ISA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-10-14)

##### `SYS-ADAS-10-08`: Conditional Weather & Time-of-Day Supplementary Sign Evaluator [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Parse auxiliary signs (e.g. 'In Wet Weather', 'School Zone 7-9 AM') against rain and clock inputs.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-10-15`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-10_ISA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-10-15), [`SWR-ADAS-10-16`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-10_ISA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-10-16)

##### `SYS-ADAS-10-09`: Instrument Cluster & Head-Up Display Speed Limit Icon Dispatcher [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Render recognized speed limit badge on instrument cluster and HUD within 150 ms of sign passing.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-10-17`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-10_ISA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-10-17), [`SWR-ADAS-10-18`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-10_ISA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-10-18)

##### `SYS-ADAS-10-10`: Overspeed Visual & Acoustic Warning Escalation Manager [ASIL B] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Flash speed badge and sound acoustic chime when vehicle speed exceeds limit by > 3 km/h.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-ADAS-10-19`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-10_ISA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-10-19), [`SWR-ADAS-10-20`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-ADAS-10_ISA_SwReq.md#swr-adas-10-20)

##### `SYS-ADAS-10-11`: Haptic Accelerator Pedal Counter-Force Pushback Actuator [ASIL A] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Apply up to 15 N counter-force to accelerator pedal to prompt driver to ease off throttle.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.

## Electric Powertrain & Energy Management

### FEAT-PWR-01: High-Voltage Battery Management System (BMS)
- **Domain:** Electric Powertrain & Energy Management | **Target ASIL:** ASIL D
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Supervises cell voltages, pack current, temperatures, insulation resistance, state estimation (SOC/SOH/SOP), and controls high-voltage pyrofuses and contactors.
- **Activation Logic:** 12V auxiliary battery connected, BMS master micro energized, interlock loop (HVIL) closed. Entry: Wakeup trigger via CAN-FD (Ignition ON, Charging Plug insertion, or Remote Preconditioning).. Deactivation: Ignition OFF with open contactor sequence completed, or HVIL loop broken, or crash pyro trigger received.. Override: Crash pyrofuse trigger line from Airbag ECU unconditionally overrides all software commands, mechanically blowing pyrofuse in < 2 ms..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-BMS-01: Prevent thermal runaway, cell overcharge (> 4.25V), cell over-discharge (< 2.50V), and short-circuit fire hazard. | FTTI: 10 ms for short circuit; 100 ms for cell overvoltage; 1000 ms for thermal limit. | Safe State: Open high-voltage main positive and negative contactors; isolate 400V/800V traction pack from vehicle chassis..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-PWR-01)

##### `SYS-PWR-01-01`: Sub-Millivolt Cell Voltage & Micro-Ohm Shunt Current Sampling [ASIL D] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL sample 192 individual series cell voltages with +-2 mV accuracy at <= 10 ms period, and total pack current with +-0.5 A accuracy at <= 1 ms period, protected with CRC-15 daisy-chain validation.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to EMERGENCY_ISOLATE if >= 3 cells become unreadable.
- **Failure Reaction:** If daisy-chain communication breaks, isolate communication loop and switch to dual-ring redundant return path.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-01-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-01), [`SWR-PWR-01-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-02), [`SWR-PWR-01-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-03)

##### `SYS-PWR-01-02`: Multi-Model State of Charge (SOC) & Dynamic Power Envelope (SOP) [ASIL C] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL compute battery pack SOC within +-3.0% accuracy across lifetime aging, and broadcast dynamic charge and discharge power limits (P_chg_max, P_dis_max in kW) every 20 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 200 ms | Safe State: Clamp discharge power limit to 20 kW (limp home) if SOC estimation confidence degrades.
- **Failure Reaction:** If OCV lookup table diverges from Coulomb counting by > 15%, latch DTC P0B0C.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-01-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-04), [`SWR-PWR-01-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-05)

##### `SYS-PWR-01-03`: High-Voltage Contactor Precharge Sequencing & Pyrofuse Firing [ASIL D] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL execute precharge sequence (closing precharge relay until DC-link voltage reaches 95% of pack voltage in <= 300 ms), and command contactor opening and pyrofuse firing in <= 5 ms under short-circuit (> 1500 A) or crash.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 5 ms | Safe State: De-energize contactor coils; verify contactor auxiliary contact opens.
- **Failure Reaction:** If main contactor welds shut, detect via post-open voltage differential and latch permanent lockout.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-01-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-06), [`SWR-PWR-01-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-07), [`SWR-PWR-01-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-08)

##### `SYS-PWR-01-04`: Active & Passive High-Efficiency Cell Balancing Management [ASIL C] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL monitor cell delta voltage (|Delta_V_cell|) during charging: If Delta_V_cell > 15 mV, activate passive bleed resistors (up to 200 mA discharge per cell) or active inductive balancing to equalize cell voltages within +-5 mV at end-of-charge.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 500 ms | Safe State: Open balancing FET switches; terminate cell discharge.
- **Failure Reaction:** If balance resistor temperature exceeds 85°C, pulse balance duty cycle down to 25%.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-01-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-09), [`SWR-PWR-01-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-10)

##### `SYS-PWR-01-05`: High-Voltage Interlock Loop (HVIL) & Chassis Insulation Monitoring [ASIL D] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL sample High-Voltage Interlock Loop (HVIL) continuity at 1 kHz and evaluate insulation resistance between HV DC bus and 12V chassis ground (> 500 ohms/volt conforming to ISO 6469-1), opening main contactors in <= 20 ms if insulation degrades below 100 ohms/volt.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Open high-voltage contactors; discharge DC link inverters.
- **Failure Reaction:** If HVIL loop breaks while driving, ramp motor torque to 0 Nm in 100 ms then open contactors.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-01-11`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-11), [`SWR-PWR-01-12`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-12)

##### `SYS-PWR-01-06`: Cell Thermal Runaway Precursor Gas & Pressure Wave Detection [ASIL D] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL monitor battery pack internal cavity pressure sensors (Delta_P > 50 mbar/s) and hydrogen/CO electrochemical gas sensors at 100 Hz, firing the pyrofuse within <= 2 ms and opening emergency pack aerosol gas vents upon thermal runaway onset.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 5 ms | Safe State: Blow pyrofuse disconnect; command cabin emergency evacuation siren.
- **Failure Reaction:** Wake up BMS micro instantly if pack enclosure burst disc switch activates.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-01-13`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-13), [`SWR-PWR-01-14`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-14)

##### `SYS-PWR-01-07`: Cell Over-Voltage Hardware Safing & Fast Contactor Trip [ASIL D] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Monitor individual cell voltages via AFE: If any cell exceeds 4.25V for > 10 ms, fire pyrofuse and open main contactors.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-01-15`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-15), [`SWR-PWR-01-16`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-16)

##### `SYS-PWR-01-08`: Cell Under-Voltage Protection & Discharge Power Limiter [ASIL D] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Derate propulsion discharge power to zero as cell voltage approaches 2.70V to prevent copper dendrite short circuits.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-01-17`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-17), [`SWR-PWR-01-18`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-18)

##### `SYS-PWR-01-09`: High-Voltage Isolation Resistance Continuous Earth Monitor [ASIL D] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Measure isolation resistance between HV bus and chassis ground: Trigger warning if isolation drops below 500 Ohm/V.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-01-19`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-19), [`SWR-PWR-01-20`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-20)

##### `SYS-PWR-01-10`: High-Voltage Interlock Loop (HVIL) Wire-Break Detector [ASIL D] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Drive continuous 20 mA square-wave through HVIL loop: If continuity is broken, de-energize contactors in <= 10 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-01-21`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-21), [`SWR-PWR-01-22`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-22)

##### `SYS-PWR-01-11`: Battery Pack Multi-Point Thermal Runaway Early Warning [ASIL D] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Detect sudden thermal gradient (> 2.0 °C/s) or off-gassing pressure spike, asserting emergency pack eject/cool down.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-01-23`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-23), [`SWR-PWR-01-24`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-24)

##### `SYS-PWR-01-12`: High-Current Pyro-Fuse Actuation & Short-Circuit Safing [ASIL D] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Trigger pyrofuse squib firing in <= 2.0 ms upon detecting severe short-circuit current exceeding 3000 A.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 5 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-01-25`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-25), [`SWR-PWR-01-26`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-26)

##### `SYS-PWR-01-13`: State of Charge (SOC) Extended Kalman Filter Observer [ASIL C] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Estimate battery pack state-of-charge with error <= 2.0% across complete charge/discharge lifecycle.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-01-27`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-27), [`SWR-PWR-01-28`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-28)

##### `SYS-PWR-01-14`: State of Health (SOH) Capacity & Internal Resistance Estimator [ASIL B] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Estimate battery degradation, capacity fade, and cell internal resistance growth during charging cycles.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 500 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-01-29`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-29), [`SWR-PWR-01-30`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-30)

##### `SYS-PWR-01-15`: Active & Passive Cell Balancing Symmetrical Switched Resistor Matrix [ASIL B] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Bleed charge from higher-voltage cells during top-balancing to maintain cell delta <= 15 mV at full charge.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 500 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-01-31`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-31), [`SWR-PWR-01-32`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-32)

##### `SYS-PWR-01-16`: DEM Non-Volatile Battery Cycle Life & Stress Buffer [ASIL B] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Log cumulative Ah throughput, temperature extremes, and DTCs in non-volatile EEPROM memory.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-01-33`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-33), [`SWR-PWR-01-34`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-01_BMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-01-34)

### FEAT-PWR-02: Traction Motor Torque Delivery & Arbitration (VCU)
- **Domain:** Electric Powertrain & Energy Management | **Target ASIL:** ASIL D
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Interprets driver pedal demands, arbitrates with ADAS/TCS/ESC, applies safety torque envelopes, and commands inverter Field-Oriented Control setpoints.
- **Activation Logic:** High-voltage system energized, inverter ready, transmission in D or R, driver seatbelt fastened, parking brake released. Entry: Driver depresses accelerator pedal OR active ADAS cruise controller issues torque demand.. Deactivation: Transmission shifted to P or N, brake pedal depressed simultaneously with accelerator (brake pedal override), or critical powertrain fault.. Override: Brake pedal press unconditionally overrides accelerator pedal, forcing requested drive torque to 0 Nm within <= 50 ms..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-VCU-01: Prevent unintended acceleration or torque direction reversal; ensure torque response matches driver intent within +-5%. | FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Zero inverter torque command (T_cmd = 0 Nm); open inverter gate drives (freewheel/active short circuit)..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-PWR-02)

##### `SYS-PWR-02-01`: Dual Accelerator Pedal Position Cross-Validation [ASIL D] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL sample two galvanically isolated, opposite-slope accelerator pedal position sensors (APP1: 0.5-4.5V, APP2: 4.5-0.5V) at <= 5 ms period. Discrepancy > 5.0% for > 100 ms SHALL force torque output to 0 Nm.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Zero driver torque request; illuminate powertrain malfunction lamp.
- **Failure Reaction:** If one sensor open-circuits, set Normalized_Pedal = 0% and report DTC P0121.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-02-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-02-01), [`SWR-PWR-02-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-02-02)

##### `SYS-PWR-02-02`: Multi-Source Torque Arbitration & Dynamic Limits Envelope [ASIL D] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL arbitrate driver torque demands, ADAS/ACC cruise demands, Traction Control (TCS) limits, and ESC stability clamping at 5 ms period, giving strict override priority to chassis safety limits.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Clamp torque to minimum of safe allowable boundary; zero torque on arbitration failure.
- **Failure Reaction:** If arbitration module detects conflicting demands, default to lowest torque request.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-02-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-02-03), [`SWR-PWR-02-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-02-04)

##### `SYS-PWR-02-03`: Inverter FOC Vector Stator Current Command Generation [ASIL D] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL translate arbitrated torque into Field-Oriented Control (FOC) stator current references (Id*, Iq*) using MTPA and field-weakening maps, updating inverter PWM controllers at 1 kHz (<= 1 ms).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Inverter PWM gate disable; trigger Safe Torque Off (STO).
- **Failure Reaction:** If rotor position tracking error > 2.0 electrical degrees, disable gate pulses.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-02-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-02-05), [`SWR-PWR-02-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-02-06)

##### `SYS-PWR-02-04`: Low-Speed Creep & Hill-Hold Anti-Rollback Controller [ASIL C] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL simulate automatic transmission creep torque (up to 40 Nm @ 0-5 km/h) when brake is released in DRIVE, and execute active motor zero-speed electrical hill-hold on inclines up to 30% without vehicle rollback (> 2 cm).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 40 ms | Safe State: Engage hydraulic ESP brake clamping; zero motor electrical hold.
- **Failure Reaction:** If electric motor overheats during sustained hill hold (> 10s), clamp foundation brakes.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-02-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-02-08), [`SWR-PWR-02-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-02-09)

##### `SYS-PWR-02-05`: Multi-Component Thermal Derating & Motor Over-Temperature Limiter [ASIL B] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL monitor stator winding temperatures (FL, FR, Rear motors) and inverter SiC MOSFET junction temperatures, smoothly derating maximum allowable drive torque (from 100% to 20% over 140°C to 175°C) to prevent thermal demagnetization.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 200 ms | Safe State: Limit motor torque to 50 Nm limp-home mode.
- **Failure Reaction:** If stator temperature exceeds 185°C, disconnect motor inverter gate drives immediately.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-02-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-02-10), [`SWR-PWR-02-11`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-02-11)

##### `SYS-PWR-02-06`: Traction Motor Multi-Channel Accelerator Pedal Cross-Check [ASIL D] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Sample dual potentiometric/Hall pedal sensors: If disagreement > 5.0% for > 30 ms, drop torque request to zero.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-02-11`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-02-11), [`SWR-PWR-02-12`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-02-12)

##### `SYS-PWR-02-07`: Inverter Space Vector Modulation (SVM) Stator Flux Controller [ASIL D] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Compute d-q axis direct and quadrature current setpoints to deliver motor electromagnetic torque with precision +-2.0 Nm.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 1 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-02-13`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-02-13), [`SWR-PWR-02-14`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-02-14)

##### `SYS-PWR-02-08`: Powertrain Dynamic Torque Arbitration (Driver vs ACC vs ESC) [ASIL D] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Arbitrate between driver demand, ADAS cruise commands, and ESC stability torque clamps with strict safety priority.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 5 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-02-15`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-02-15), [`SWR-PWR-02-16`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-02-16)

##### `SYS-PWR-02-09`: Motor Rotor Resolver-to-Digital Angle Decoding & Position Observer [ASIL D] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Decode high-speed resolver feedback with 16-bit resolution to synchronize stator rotating magnetic field.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 1 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-02-17`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-02-17), [`SWR-PWR-02-18`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-02-18)

##### `SYS-PWR-02-10`: Active Inverter Discharge & DC Link Capacitor Bleed Resistor Manager [ASIL D] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Discharge 800V DC link capacitor to < 60V in <= 2.0 seconds upon crash signal or ignition shutdown.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-02-19`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-02-19), [`SWR-PWR-02-20`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-02-20)

##### `SYS-PWR-02-11`: Traction Inverter Phase Over-Current Hardware Trip Monitor [ASIL D] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Hardware comparator trips all 6 IGBT/SiC gate drives in < 2.0 µs upon current exceeding 850 A peak.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 1 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-02-21`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-02-21), [`SWR-PWR-02-22`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-02-22)

##### `SYS-PWR-02-12`: Motor Stator Winding & Rotor Magnet Multi-Zone Thermal Derater [ASIL B] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Derate peak motor torque continuously from 400 Nm to 120 Nm as winding temperature rises from 140 °C to 165 °C.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-02-23`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-02-23), [`SWR-PWR-02-24`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-02_Torque_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-02-24)

##### `SYS-PWR-02-13`: Creep Torque & Hill Hold Powertrain Standstill Speed Governor [ASIL B] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Govern low-speed vehicle creep velocity to 4.0 km/h and prevent vehicle roll-back on 20% slopes.
