### FEAT-PWR-03: Regenerative Braking & One-Pedal Drive Coordination (RBC)
- **Domain:** Electric Powertrain & Energy Management | **Target ASIL:** ASIL D
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Recuperates kinetic energy during deceleration, blends electric regeneration with friction brakes, provides One-Pedal Drive standstill hold, and cuts off regen during ABS events.
- **Activation Logic:** High-voltage battery accepting charge, inverter operational, transmission in D, vehicle speed > 3 km/h. Entry: Driver lifts foot off accelerator pedal (coast-down regen) OR depresses brake pedal (blended brake regen).. Deactivation: Battery SOC > 98%, ABS intervention active, ESC active, vehicle stationary, or reverse gear selected.. Override: Driver hard brake pedal press adds hydraulic friction braking seamlessly without lag..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-RBC-01: Prevent rear-axle lockup or vehicle instability during regenerative braking; ensure seamless brake pedal deceleration feel. | FTTI: 20 ms for ABS cutoff; 100 ms for blended torque transitions. | Safe State: Zero regenerative braking torque (T_regen = 0 Nm); transfer 100% deceleration demand to hydraulic foundation brakes..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-PWR-03)

##### `SYS-PWR-03-01`: Deceleration Blending Allocation Between Regen & Hydraulic Brakes [ASIL C] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL allocate up to -0.35 g deceleration to electric generator recuperation before applying hydraulic friction brakes, accounting for battery charge power limits and motor thermal status at 10 ms period.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Disengage regen; satisfy 100% deceleration demand via hydraulic friction brakes.
- **Failure Reaction:** If brake pedal stroke sensor reports erratic values, disable regen blending.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-03-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-03-01), [`SWR-PWR-03-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-03-02)

##### `SYS-PWR-03-02`: High-Speed ABS/ESC Intervention Regeneration Cutoff [ASIL D] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL ramp regenerative motor braking torque to 0.0 Nm in <= 20 ms upon receipt of ABS_Active == TRUE or ESC_Intervention == TRUE from chassis controller to maintain lateral tire traction.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Zero regen torque output; withhold regen for 500 ms post-event.
- **Failure Reaction:** If chassis communication packet times out, unconditionally disable regen braking.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-03-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-03-03), [`SWR-PWR-03-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-03-04)

##### `SYS-PWR-03-03`: ABS Wheel Slip Fast Regeneration Cutback & Surface Coordination [ASIL D] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL reduce regenerative motor braking torque to 0 Nm in <= 20 ms upon ESP detecting wheel slip (slip ratio lambda > 12% on low-friction road surfaces), transferring 100% deceleration to modulated hydraulic ABS.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Zero electric motor regen torque; enable hydraulic ABS.
- **Failure Reaction:** If motor torque ramp-down is delayed > 25 ms, open inverter PWM gates.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-03-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-03-05), [`SWR-PWR-03-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-03-06)

##### `SYS-PWR-03-04`: Battery Low-Temperature & High SOC Regeneration Envelope Limiter [ASIL C] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL dynamically scale regenerative deceleration based on battery BMS charge acceptance limit (P_chg_max): Seamlessly substituting hydraulic friction braking to maintain consistent driver pedal decel feel when battery is cold (< 0°C) or fully charged (> 95% SOC).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Rely 100% on foundation hydraulic brakes for deceleration.
- **Failure Reaction:** If BMS broadcast drops, restrict regen power to 0 kW.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-03-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-03-07), [`SWR-PWR-03-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-03-08)

##### `SYS-PWR-03-05`: Regenerative Braking Deceleration Intent & Pedal Stroke Mapper [ASIL D] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Map brake pedal initial stroke (0 to 15 mm) to regenerative deceleration torque (up to -0.3g) seamlessly.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-03-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-03-09), [`SWR-PWR-03-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-03-10)

##### `SYS-PWR-03-06`: One-Pedal Drive Accelerator Lift-Off Deceleration Synthesizer [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Synthesize progressive deceleration (up to -0.22g) as driver lifts off accelerator pedal, bringing car to complete stop.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-03-11`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-03-11), [`SWR-PWR-03-12`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-03-12)

##### `SYS-PWR-03-07`: Hydraulic Foundation & Electric Motor Torque Blending Coordinator [ASIL D] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Blend electric regen torque with hydraulic friction brakes: Prioritize regen while preserving total driver deceleration.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-03-13`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-03-13), [`SWR-PWR-03-14`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-03-14)

##### `SYS-PWR-03-08`: ABS Wheel Slip Detection & Instantaneous Regen Cutoff Safing [ASIL D] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Cut electric regenerative braking torque to zero in <= 20 ms upon ABS activation to ensure directional stability.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-03-15`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-03-15), [`SWR-PWR-03-16`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-03-16)

##### `SYS-PWR-03-09`: High-Voltage Battery Full Charge (SOC > 95%) Regen Derating Envelope [ASIL C] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Smoothly reduce regenerative braking capability from 100% to 0% as battery SOC rises from 92% to 98%.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-03-17`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-03-17), [`SWR-PWR-03-18`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-03-18)

##### `SYS-PWR-03-10`: Low-Temperature Battery Pack Regen Current Ingestion Limiter [ASIL C] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Limit maximum regen charging current when battery temperature < 0 °C to prevent lithium plating damage.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-03-19`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-03-19), [`SWR-PWR-03-20`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-03-20)

##### `SYS-PWR-03-11`: Front/Rear Axle Regen Braking Stability Distribution Law [ASIL D] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Distribute regenerative deceleration between front and rear e-axles according to dynamic tire friction limits.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-03-21`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-03-21), [`SWR-PWR-03-22`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-03-22)

##### `SYS-PWR-03-12`: Powertrain Regen Active Driveline Damping & Anti-Shudder Filter [ASIL B] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Apply anti-resonance notch filter to regen torque demands to eliminate driveline backlash clunk and judder.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-03-23`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-03-23), [`SWR-PWR-03-24`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-03_Regen_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-03-24)

##### `SYS-PWR-03-13`: Regenerative Deceleration Brake Lamp Automatic Illumination [ASIL B] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Illuminate vehicle rear brake lamps automatically whenever regenerative deceleration exceeds -0.7 m/s² (ECE R13H).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.

### FEAT-PWR-04: Thermal Management & Heat Pump System (TMS)
- **Domain:** Electric Powertrain & Energy Management | **Target ASIL:** ASIL B
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-PWR-04_TMS_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-PWR-04_TMS_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-PWR-04_TMS_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-04_TMS_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Coordinates battery chillers, electric coolant pumps, multi-way valves, and refrigerant heat pump to optimize cabin comfort, battery temperature, and powertrain cooling.
- **Activation Logic:** 12V electrical system powered, high-voltage battery ready, ambient temperature sensors functional. Entry: Battery preconditioning request, cabin HVAC on, or component temperature exceeds thermal target.. Deactivation: Ignition OFF and component temperatures within rest targets, or high-voltage crash isolation.. Override: Battery thermal runaway precursor temperature (> 60°C) unconditionally prioritizes 100% cooling capacity to battery pack..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-TMS-01: Prevent battery pack overheating and maintain safe component temperatures during fast charging. | FTTI: 2000 ms | Safe State: Open high-voltage coolant heaters; command cooling fans and water pumps to 100% maximum speed..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-PWR-04)

##### `SYS-PWR-04-01`: Battery Pack Temperature Regulation & Fast-Charge Preconditioning [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL maintain battery cell temperatures within optimal window (20°C to 35°C during driving, 25°C to 45°C during DC fast charging) by modulating 5-way coolant valves and electric chillers at 100 ms period.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 1000 ms | Safe State: Derate DC fast-charge rate if coolant temperature exceeds 45°C.
- **Failure Reaction:** If chiller expansion valve fails, command max radiator fan bypass.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-04-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-04_TMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-04-01), [`SWR-PWR-04-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-04_TMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-04-02)

##### `SYS-PWR-04-02`: Powertrain Inverter & Motor Waste Heat Recovery Loop [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL scavenge waste heat from traction motor and inverter (up to 4 kW thermal power) using refrigerant heat pump loop to heat vehicle cabin in winter environments (-20°C to +10°C).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 2000 ms | Safe State: Engage high-voltage PTC auxiliary heater if waste heat is insufficient.
- **Failure Reaction:** If heat pump loop pressure exceeds 32 bar, cycle compressor off.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-04-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-04_TMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-04-03), [`SWR-PWR-04-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-04_TMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-04-04)

##### `SYS-PWR-04-03`: Heat Pump Multi-Port Coolant Valve Position Servocontrol [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Position 8-way octovalve coolant manifold stepper motors with angular accuracy +-1.5° to route thermal loops.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-04-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-04_TMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-04-05), [`SWR-PWR-04-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-04_TMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-04-06)

##### `SYS-PWR-04-04`: Electric Scroll AC Compressor High-Voltage Inverter Speed Governor [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Regulate 800V electric compressor rotational speed between 800 RPM and 8500 RPM via CAN-FD setpoints.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-04-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-04_TMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-04-07), [`SWR-PWR-04-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-04_TMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-04-08)

##### `SYS-PWR-04-05`: Battery Pack Liquid Chiller Heat Exchanger Thermal Regulator [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Maintain battery coolant inlet temperature within optimal 25 °C to 35 °C window during DC fast charging.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-04-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-04_TMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-04-09), [`SWR-PWR-04-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-04_TMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-04-10)

##### `SYS-PWR-04-06`: Traction Inverter & Motor Waste Heat Scavenging Recirculator [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Scavenge powertrain waste heat from drive units to heat cabin during sub-zero ambient winter driving.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-04-11`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-04_TMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-04-11), [`SWR-PWR-04-12`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-04_TMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-04-12)

##### `SYS-PWR-04-07`: Cabin Evaporator Anti-Frost & Electronic Expansion Valve (EXV) Controller [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Modulate EXV orifice opening via PWM to maintain superheat target (5.0 K) and prevent evaporator core freeze-up.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-04-13`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-04_TMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-04-13), [`SWR-PWR-04-14`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-04_TMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-04-14)

##### `SYS-PWR-04-08`: High-Voltage Positive Temperature Coefficient (PTC) Cabin Heater Driver [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Modulate 6.0 kW HV PTC ceramic heater current using PWM power stage to deliver rapid cabin warmup.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-04-15`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-04_TMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-04-15), [`SWR-PWR-04-16`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-04_TMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-04-16)

##### `SYS-PWR-04-09`: Refrigerant Circuit High/Low Pressure Transducer Plausibility Monitor [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Sample pressure transducers: Trip compressor shutdown if discharge pressure exceeds 32.0 bar.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-04-17`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-04_TMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-04-17), [`SWR-PWR-04-18`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-04_TMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-04-18)

##### `SYS-PWR-04-10`: Radiator Active Grille Shutter (AGS) Aerodynamic Drag Optimizer [ASIL B] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Modulate motorized aerodynamic grille shutters (0% closed to 100% open) based on vehicle speed and thermal demand.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 200 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-04-19`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-04_TMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-04-19), [`SWR-PWR-04-20`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-04_TMS_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-04-20)

##### `SYS-PWR-04-11`: Coolant Loop Degas Reservoir Fluid Level Sensor Debouncer [ASIL B] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Debounce reed-switch coolant level sensor to alert driver to coolant loss before pump cavitates.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 500 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.

##### `SYS-PWR-04-12`: Sub-Zero Ambient Battery Preconditioning Target Thermal Scheduler [ASIL B] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Pre-heat battery pack to 30 °C prior to scheduled DC fast charging arrival using route navigation cues.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 1000 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.

### FEAT-PWR-05: On-Board Charger & DC Fast Charging System (OBC-DCFC)
- **Domain:** Electric Powertrain & Energy Management | **Target ASIL:** ASIL C
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-PWR-05_OBC_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-PWR-05_OBC_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-PWR-05_OBC_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-05_OBC_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Controls AC Level 2 charging via 11 kW/22 kW on-board converter, communicates with DC fast chargers via ISO 15118 (Plug & Charge), and manages inlet lock actuators.
- **Activation Logic:** Vehicle parked in PARK, charging inlet door opened, charging cable plugged in. Entry: Control Pilot (CP) signal detected; Proximity Pilot (PP) resistance validated; authentication handshake completed.. Deactivation: User commands stop via app, connector unlocked, battery reaches 100% target, or ground fault detected.. Override: Emergency charge stop button or mechanical emergency release cable immediately halts charging and opens contactors in < 10 ms..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-OBC-01: Prevent electrical shock, vehicle drive-away with cable plugged in, and high-voltage DC arcing during disconnect. | FTTI: 20 ms for ground fault; 100 ms for pilot disconnect. | Safe State: Open high-voltage charging contactors; lock vehicle immobilizer in PARK..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-PWR-05)

##### `SYS-PWR-05-01`: Control Pilot & Proximity Pilot State Evaluation (IEC 61851 / SAE J1772) [ASIL C] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL sample Control Pilot (CP +-12V PWM) duty cycle and Proximity Pilot (PP) resistance at <= 5 ms period, deriving maximum available grid current (6A to 80A) and verifying cable latch engagement.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: De-energize on-board charger power stages if CP voltage drops from State C to State A/B.
- **Failure Reaction:** If inlet latch motor fails to lock, disallow charging to prevent hot disconnect arcing.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-05-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-05_OBC_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-05-01), [`SWR-PWR-05-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-05_OBC_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-05-02)

##### `SYS-PWR-05-02`: ISO 15118 High-Level Communication & Plug & Charge Handshake [ASIL B / ISO 21434] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL negotiate charging parameters with external DC fast chargers via HomePlug Green PHY Power-Line Communication (PLC) using ISO 15118-2/20 protocols, supporting TLS 1.3 cryptographic authentication within <= 5.0 seconds.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 500 ms | Safe State: Terminate session; open charging contactors.
- **Failure Reaction:** If certificate validation fails, display 'Authentication Error' on central screen.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-05-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-05_OBC_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-05-03), [`SWR-PWR-05-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-05_OBC_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-05-04)

##### `SYS-PWR-05-03`: AC Grid L1/L2/L3 Voltage & Phase Angle Phase-Locked Loop (PLL) Tracker [ASIL C] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Synchronize on-board charger active power factor correction (PFC) bridge with grid AC line frequency (50/60 Hz).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 1 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-05-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-05_OBC_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-05-05), [`SWR-PWR-05-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-05_OBC_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-05-06)

##### `SYS-PWR-05-04`: On-Board Charger Bidirectional PFC Bridge PWM Space Vector Modulator [ASIL C] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Regulate AC mains current to achieve unity power factor (PF > 0.99) and THD < 3.0% at up to 22 kW AC charge.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 1 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-05-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-05_OBC_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-05-07), [`SWR-PWR-05-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-05_OBC_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-05-08)

##### `SYS-PWR-05-05`: Galvanic Isolated LLC Resonant DC-DC Converter Secondary Rectifier [ASIL C] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Control high-frequency resonant LLC converter switching frequency (100-250 kHz) to step DC voltage to battery.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 1 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-05-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-05_OBC_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-05-09), [`SWR-PWR-05-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-05_OBC_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-05-10)

- **Statement:** The System SHALL Close pre-charge circuit to match off-board charger DC voltage within +-10V of battery pack before main contactors.

### FEAT-PWR-06: Bidirectional Vehicle-to-Load & Vehicle-to-Grid (V2L / V2G)
- **Domain:** Electric Powertrain & Energy Management | **Target ASIL:** ASIL C
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-PWR-06_V2L_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-PWR-06_V2L_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-PWR-06_V2L_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-06_V2L_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Transforms the vehicle into an off-grid AC power station (up to 3.6 kW V2L / 11 kW V2H/V2G), managing galvanic isolation, anti-islanding, and household grid synchronization.
- **Activation Logic:** Vehicle parked in PARK, battery SOC between 20% and 100%, V2L adapter plugged into charge port, ground loop verified. Entry: User activates 'V2L Power Outlet' via infotainment screen or smartphone app; selects minimum battery reserve cutoff (e.g. 20%).. Deactivation: User commands stop, battery reaches reserve cutoff, ground fault detected, or plug physically removed.. Override: Emergency release of charging plug or detection of grid backfeed immediately disconnects AC contactors in < 10 ms..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-V2L-01: Prevent lethal electric shock (touch voltage < 50V AC); prevent islanding backfeed into unpowered utility grid (IEEE 1547 / UL 1741). | FTTI: 20 ms for residual current ground fault; 100 ms for anti-islanding trip. | Safe State: Open bidirectional inverter AC relays; discharge inverter bridge filter capacitors..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-PWR-06)

##### `SYS-PWR-06-01`: Residual Current & Earth Bonding Impedance Verification [ASIL C] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL verify earth bonding resistance (< 5 ohms) and continuously monitor residual AC and DC leakage current (tripping at AC > 30 mA or DC > 6 mA) in <= 20 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: De-energize AC output relays; isolate 230V/120V outlet socket.
- **Failure Reaction:** If ground bonding missing, prohibit inverter startup and display 'Earth Fault'.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-06-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-06_V2L_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-06-01), [`SWR-PWR-06-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-06_V2L_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-06-02)

##### `SYS-PWR-06-02`: Pure Sine-Wave AC Inverter Voltage & Frequency Regulation [ASIL C] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL synthesize pure sine wave AC voltage (230V +-3% @ 50 Hz or 120V +-3% @ 60 Hz) with Total Harmonic Distortion (THD) < 3.0% under loads up to 3600 W (continuous) and 4500 W (10s peak).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Clamp PWM duty cycle to zero; shutdown DC-AC H-bridge.
- **Failure Reaction:** If load current exceeds 20A for > 1.0 second, shut down on thermal overload.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-06-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-06_V2L_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-06-03), [`SWR-PWR-06-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-06_V2L_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-06-04)

##### `SYS-PWR-06-03`: V2L AC Islanding Grid Synthesizer & Autonomous Voltage Regulator [ASIL C] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Synthesize stable 230V / 120V single-phase AC island grid (50/60 Hz +-0.1 Hz) supplying up to 3.6 kW off-grid load.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 1 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-06-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-06_V2L_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-06-05), [`SWR-PWR-06-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-06_V2L_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-06-06)

##### `SYS-PWR-06-04`: V2G Bi-Directional Grid-Tied Synchronization & Active Power Dispatcher [ASIL C] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Synchronize inverter output with utility grid phase and dispatch active/reactive power (P/Q) per utility request.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 5 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-06-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-06_V2L_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-06-07), [`SWR-PWR-06-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-06_V2L_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-06-08)

##### `SYS-PWR-06-05`: V2L Inrush Current & Overload Electronic Circuit Breaker Safing [ASIL C] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Trip electronic inverter output in <= 5 ms upon detecting load overcurrent exceeding 150% rating.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 2 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-06-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-06_V2L_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-06-09), [`SWR-PWR-06-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-06_V2L_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-06-10)

##### `SYS-PWR-06-06`: Anti-Islanding Utility Power Cut Detection & Immediate Disconnect [ASIL C] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Detect utility grid blackout via active frequency drift: Disconnect from grid within <= 100 ms (IEEE 1547).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 5 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-06-11`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-06_V2L_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-06-11), [`SWR-PWR-06-12`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-06_V2L_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-06-12)

- **Statement:** The System SHALL Halt V2L power export when vehicle battery state-of-charge drops below user-selected threshold (e.g. 20%).

### FEAT-PWR-07: Electric Axle Disconnect & Multi-Speed Shifting (e-Axle)
- **Domain:** Electric Powertrain & Energy Management | **Target ASIL:** ASIL C
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-PWR-07_eAxle_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-PWR-07_eAxle_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-PWR-07_eAxle_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-07_eAxle_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Coordinates electro-mechanical dog clutch disconnects and multi-speed EV transmission shifting to optimize high-speed highway efficiency and low-speed wheel torque.
- **Activation Logic:** 12V system healthy, transmission oil temperature within range (-30°C to +120°C), motor speed synchronization operational. Entry: Vehicle cruising at highway speeds in ECO mode (disconnect front axle) OR hard acceleration tip-in (downshift Gear 2 to Gear 1).. Deactivation: Vehicle stationary or transmission shifted to PARK.. Override: Kickdown pedal press or slip detection immediately forces low gear engagement and re-connects disconnected axle in <= 150 ms..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-AXLE-01: Prevent unintended driveline disconnect during regenerative braking; prevent dog clutch mechanical clash or gear locking at high speed. | FTTI: 80 ms | Safe State: Synchronize motor speed; hold dog clutch in locked coupled position..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-PWR-07)

##### `SYS-PWR-07-01`: High-Speed Speed-Match Synchronization & Shift Coordination [ASIL C] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL zero traction motor torque, ramp motor RPM to match target transmission gear shaft speed within +-20 RPM in <= 200 ms, and actuate dog clutch sleeve to complete gear shift in <= 350 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 80 ms | Safe State: Abort gear shift; re-engage previous gear; limit motor torque to 50%.
- **Failure Reaction:** If sleeve position sensor reports stuck-in-neutral, ramp motor torque to zero.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-07-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-07_eAxle_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-07-01), [`SWR-PWR-07-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-07_eAxle_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-07-02)

##### `SYS-PWR-07-02`: Front-Axle Disconnect Dog Clutch Mechanical Decoupling [ASIL C] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL actuate an electromagnetic dog clutch to mechanically decouple secondary front e-Axle during steady-state cruising, eliminating rotor windage and drag losses in <= 100 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 80 ms | Safe State: Keep clutch energized in CLOSED coupled position.
- **Failure Reaction:** If clutch position feedback uncertain, default to 100% AWD coupled state.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-07-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-07_eAxle_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-07-03), [`SWR-PWR-07-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-07_eAxle_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-07-04)

##### `SYS-PWR-07-03`: Electric Axle Dog-Clutch Disconnect Solenoid Actuator Position Controller [ASIL C] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Control hydraulic/electromechanical dog clutch actuator to connect/disconnect secondary axle in <= 150 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-07-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-07_eAxle_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-07-05), [`SWR-PWR-07-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-07_eAxle_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-07-06)

##### `SYS-PWR-07-04`: Secondary Motor Zero-Torque Speed Synchronization Prior to Engagement [ASIL C] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Synchronize secondary traction motor speed to road speed within +-20 RPM before engaging mechanical clutch.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-07-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-07_eAxle_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-07-07), [`SWR-PWR-07-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-07_eAxle_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-07-08)

##### `SYS-PWR-07-05`: 2-Speed Planetary Gearbox Dual-Brake Shift Sequencing Engine [ASIL C] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Coordinate friction clutch release and brake band apply to execute 1st to 2nd gear shift in <= 300 ms without torque hole.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-07-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-07_eAxle_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-07-09), [`SWR-PWR-07-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-07_eAxle_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-07-10)

##### `SYS-PWR-07-06`: Shift Drum Electromechanical Rotary Encoder Angle Closed-Loop Servo [ASIL C] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Position shifting drum stepper motor with angular accuracy <= 0.5° across neutral, low, and high gear detents.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 5 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-07-11`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-07_eAxle_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-07-11), [`SWR-PWR-07-12`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-07_eAxle_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-07-12)

##### `SYS-PWR-07-07`: Mechanical Jam & Spline Tooth-on-Tooth Collision Re-Try Logic [ASIL C] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Detect spline misalignment upon engagement; oscillate motor speed by +-50 RPM to facilitate smooth tooth engagement.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-07-13`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-07_eAxle_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-07-13), [`SWR-PWR-07-14`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-07_eAxle_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-07-14)

##### `SYS-PWR-07-08`: Axle Disconnect Drag Reduction Efficiency Maximizer [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Automatically disconnect secondary front/rear e-axle during steady-state highway cruising to eliminate spin drag.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-07-15`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-07_eAxle_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-07-15), [`SWR-PWR-07-16`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-07_eAxle_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-07-16)

##### `SYS-PWR-07-09`: Cold Temperature Gearbox Oil Viscosity Warming & Shift Inhibit Governor [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Inhibit high-speed 2nd-gear shifting when gearbox transmission oil temperature < -10 °C until warmed up.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 500 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-PWR-07-17`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-07_eAxle_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-07-17), [`SWR-PWR-07-18`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-PWR-07_eAxle_SwReq.md#swr-pwr-07-18)

##### `SYS-PWR-07-10`: Emergency All-Wheel Drive Instantaneous Axle Re-Connect Dispatcher [ASIL C] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Re-engage disconnected e-axle in <= 200 ms upon detecting wheel slip or ESC stability intervention trigger.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.

## Vehicle Motion & Chassis Control

### FEAT-CHS-01: Electronic Stability Control (ESC)
- **Domain:** Vehicle Motion & Chassis Control | **Target ASIL:** ASIL D
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Stabilizes vehicle yaw dynamics during extreme cornering and low-friction situations by applying individual-wheel hydraulic braking and demanding powertrain torque reductions.
- **Activation Logic:** Ignition in RUN, vehicle speed > 8 km/h, hydraulic pressure sensor healthy, 6-DOF IMU calibrated. Entry: Yaw rate error (|Delta_YawRate| > 0.08 rad/s) OR vehicle sideslip angle (|Beta| > 4.5 deg) exceeds dynamic instability threshold.. Deactivation: Vehicle yaw rate and sideslip return within linear stable envelope for > 200 ms, or vehicle comes to complete stop.. Override: Driver can select 'ESC Sport' (raising intervention threshold by 40%), but system cannot be completely defeated if collision is detected..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-ESC-01: Prevent uncontrolled vehicle spin-out or drift-out; avoid unintended asymmetric braking on dry straight roads. | FTTI: 40 ms | Safe State: De-energize all hydraulic solenoid valves (return to open circuit); restore 100% standard driver hydraulic pass-through..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-CHS-01)

##### `SYS-CHS-01-01`: Bicycle Reference Model & Vehicle Sideslip Observer [ASIL D] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL sample 6-DOF IMU (yaw rate, lateral acceleration) and 4 wheel speed sensors at 100 Hz, calculating desired yaw rate and vehicle body sideslip angle (Beta +- 0.5 deg) at <= 10 ms period.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 30 ms | Safe State: Invalidate observer outputs; suspend active ESC interventions.
- **Failure Reaction:** If wheel speed pulse drops, isolate affected wheel and use remaining 3 wheels for velocity estimation.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-01-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-01), [`SWR-CHS-01-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-02)

##### `SYS-CHS-01-02`: Differential Individual-Wheel Pressure & Engine Torque Reduction [ASIL D] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL build up hydraulic braking pressure up to 120 bar on targeted individual wheels in <= 120 ms to create corrective yaw moments, while demanding fast powertrain torque reduction via CAN-FD in <= 20 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 40 ms | Safe State: Open hydraulic release valves; zero torque reduction request.
- **Failure Reaction:** If hydraulic pump motor overheats, limit maximum intervention duration to 5.0 seconds.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-01-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-03), [`SWR-CHS-01-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-04)

##### `SYS-CHS-01-03`: Split-Mu Low-Friction Differential Braking & Steer-Correction [ASIL D] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL detect split-friction road surfaces (e.g. ice on right wheels, dry asphalt on left wheels during braking), commanding asymmetric caliper pressure and electric power steering counter-torque (+-2.5 Nm) in <= 30 ms to prevent vehicle swerving.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 30 ms | Safe State: Symmetrize braking pressures; zero EPS counter-steering torque.
- **Failure Reaction:** If EPS communication drops, reduce braking pressure on high-friction wheels to preserve directional stability.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-01-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-05), [`SWR-CHS-01-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-06)

##### `SYS-CHS-01-04`: Active Rollover Mitigation (ARM) & Tripping Prevention [ASIL D] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL sample 6-DOF IMU roll rate (p_roll) and lateral acceleration (a_y) at 100 Hz: If estimated wheel lift is detected, system SHALL build 80 bar braking pressure on outer front wheel in <= 80 ms while clamping powertrain torque to zero to mitigate rollover.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 40 ms | Safe State: Release brake pressure once roll angle drops below 3.0 degrees.
- **Failure Reaction:** If IMU roll gyro faults, estimate roll risk from lateral acceleration and steering angle.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-01-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-07), [`SWR-CHS-01-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-08)

##### `SYS-CHS-01-05`: Emergency Hydraulic Brake Assist (HBA) Dynamic Pressure Booster [ASIL D] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL detect panic braking (pedal travel rate d(pedal)/dt > 300 %/s or pressure rise dP/dt > 200 bar/s) and automatically override driver pedal force to command full ABS lock-limit pressure (120 bar) in <= 60 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 30 ms | Safe State: Rely on driver manual physical hydraulic master cylinder pressure.
- **Failure Reaction:** Release booster override immediately when driver releases brake pedal.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-01-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-09), [`SWR-CHS-01-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-10)

##### `SYS-CHS-01-06`: Traction Control System (TCS) Wheel Slip Acceleration Limiter [ASIL D] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL sample all four wheel speed sensors at 100 Hz, detect excessive driven wheel slip (> 10% relative to vehicle reference speed), and command motor torque reduction in <= 15 ms while applying drive wheel brake intervention.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 30 ms | Safe State: Zero TCS brake pressure request; restore driver requested torque.
- **Failure Reaction:** If one wheel speed sensor drops out, estimate axle speed from opposite wheel.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-01-11`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-11), [`SWR-CHS-01-12`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-12)

##### `SYS-CHS-01-07`: Hydraulic Brake Proportioning & Electronic Brakeforce Distribution (EBD) [ASIL D] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL compute dynamic rear-axle brake pressure proportioning based on dynamic axle load transfer, limiting rear caliper pressure to prevent rear wheel lockup prior to front wheel lockup across all vehicle payloads.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 25 ms | Safe State: Revert to fixed baseline mechanical hydraulic proportioning curve.
- **Failure Reaction:** If rear pressure sensor faults, cap rear pressure to 65% of front master pressure.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-01-13`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-13), [`SWR-CHS-01-14`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-14)

##### `SYS-CHS-01-08`: Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) High-Frequency Pressure Modulation [ASIL D] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL modulate individual wheel hydraulic caliper pressure between 0 bar and 140 bar at up to 25 Hz modulation frequency when wheel slip exceeds optimal tire friction peak (slip ratio > 15%), maintaining maximum steerability and shortest stopping distance.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Open all inlet solenoid valves; vent outlet valves to unpressurized reservoir.
- **Failure Reaction:** If wheel solenoid valve sticks closed, open dump circuit to prevent wheel lockup.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-01-15`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-15), [`SWR-CHS-01-16`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-16)

##### `SYS-CHS-01-09`: Hill Start Assist (HSA) & Drive-Off Rollback Suppression [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL hold foundation brake pressure (minimum 25 bar) on uphill inclines (> 3.0% grade) for up to 2000 ms after driver releases the brake pedal, releasing pressure in <= 50 ms once powertrain delivered torque exceeds incline roll resistance.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Release hydraulic hold pressure; illuminate hill-hold indicator.
- **Failure Reaction:** If incline sensor signal is corrupted, engage EPB automatic hold.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-01-17`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-17), [`SWR-CHS-01-18`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-18)

##### `SYS-CHS-01-10`: Hydraulic Brake Fade Compensation (HBFC) Thermal Booster [ASIL D] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL estimate brake rotor temperature via energy dissipation observer: When thermal rotor fade causes deceleration loss (|a_x| < 0.6g at 100 bar master pressure), system SHALL automatically boost hydraulic line pressure by up to +40 bar using ESC return pump.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 40 ms | Safe State: Zero supplementary hydraulic boost; rely on driver manual pedal force.
- **Failure Reaction:** If pump motor overheats, clamp boost pressure to +15 bar.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-01-19`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-19), [`SWR-CHS-01-20`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-20)

##### `SYS-CHS-01-11`: Trailer Stability Assist (TSA) Snaking Oscillation Damper [ASIL D] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL sample IMU yaw rate at 100 Hz, detect alternating trailer snaking yaw oscillations (frequency 0.8 Hz to 1.5 Hz, yaw rate amplitude > 0.05 rad/s), and apply alternating individual front caliper braking in <= 40 ms to dampen oscillation.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 40 ms | Safe State: Suspend differential braking; apply symmetrical gentle deceleration.
- **Failure Reaction:** If trailer connection signal fluctuates, verify trailer presence via yaw spectrum.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-01-21`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-21), [`SWR-CHS-01-22`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-22)

##### `SYS-CHS-01-12`: Brake Disc Wiping (BDW) Wet Weather Film Remover [ASIL B] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL detect windshield wiper continuous operation (wiper stage 1 or 2): System SHALL cyclically apply 1.5 bar caliper pressure for 500 ms every 180 seconds to wipe water film from brake discs without inducing noticeable vehicle deceleration (decel < 0.02 m/s²).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 500 ms | Safe State: Zero wiping pressure; disable BDW function.
- **Failure Reaction:** Inhibit wiping if driver is depressing accelerator pedal > 30%.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-01-23`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-23), [`SWR-CHS-01-24`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-24)

##### `SYS-CHS-01-13`: Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB) Deceleration Decoupling & Pressure Actuation [ASIL D] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL receive AEB autonomous deceleration demands (up to -9.0 m/s²) over chassis CAN-FD with E2E Profile 5 CRC, building 100 bar hydraulic pressure across all four calipers in <= 150 ms with tracking error <= 3.0 bar.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 25 ms | Safe State: Release autonomous pressure; transition to driver manual hydraulic pass-through.
- **Failure Reaction:** If CAN-FD communication drops, abort autonomous pressure build within 40 ms.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-01-25`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-25), [`SWR-CHS-01-26`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-26)

##### `SYS-CHS-01-14`: Torque Vectoring by Braking (TVB) Agility Enhancer [ASIL B] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL detect high lateral acceleration cornering (a_y > 0.4g, understeer gradient > 1.2): System SHALL apply light hydraulic pressure (5 to 25 bar) to the inside rear wheel in <= 30 ms to induce a yaw moment into the turn without slowing vehicle.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Zero TVB inside wheel pressure; maintain neutral open differential.
- **Failure Reaction:** Inhibit TVB if brake rotor temperature exceeds 350 °C.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-01-27`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-27), [`SWR-CHS-01-28`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-28)

##### `SYS-CHS-01-15`: Electronic Stability Control Watchdog & Core Lockstep Safing Monitor [ASIL D] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL execute continuous hardware watchdog challenge-response and cross-core lockstep ALU comparison at 1000 Hz: If CPU cores diverge or execution flow exceeds 2.0 ms deadline, hardware safing relay SHALL de-energize all 12 hydraulic valves to open state within <= 4.0 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: De-energize all solenoid valves; restore 100% mechanical master cylinder pass-through.
- **Failure Reaction:** Hardware reset and latch unrecoverable safety shutdown until key-off.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-01-29`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-29), [`SWR-CHS-01-30`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-30), [`SWR-CHS-01-31`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-31)

##### `SYS-CHS-01-16`: Diagnostic Event Management (DEM) & Hydraulic Valve Stiction Self-Test [ASIL D] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL perform an automated hydraulic valve micro-pulse self-test upon vehicle startup: Measure coil inductive flyback decay current (< 500 µs), confirm zero hydraulic pressure rise, and qualify DTCs with freeze-frame storage in non-volatile memory within <= 50 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Inhibit active ESC interventions; latch amber tell-tale on cluster.
- **Failure Reaction:** If valve coil open/short detected, disable affected circuit and record DTC C1020.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-01-32`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-32), [`SWR-CHS-01-33`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-33), [`SWR-CHS-01-34`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-34), [`SWR-CHS-01-35`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-35), [`SWR-CHS-01-36`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-01_ESC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-01-36)

### FEAT-CHS-02: Steer-by-Wire Handwheel & Rack Control (SbW)
- **Domain:** Vehicle Motion & Chassis Control | **Target ASIL:** ASIL D
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-CHS-02_SbW_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-CHS-02_SbW_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-CHS-02_SbW_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-02_SbW_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Decoupled steering system replacing mechanical steering column with dual-redundant roadwheel rack actuators and a force-feedback handwheel actuator.
- **Activation Logic:** Dual independent 12V/48V power supplies healthy, dual microcontrollers synchronized, rack resolvers calibrated. Entry: Vehicle power-up; handwheel homing completed; both redundant actuator channels reporting operational readiness.. Deactivation: Power shutdown or irrecoverable mechanical rack jam.. Override: Driver physical handwheel torque is continuously tracked and converted to roadwheel angle; force-feedback motor provides synthesized road feel..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-SBW-01: Guarantee fail-operational lateral directional control; zero uncommanded steering motion; fail-operational redundancy upon any single electrical fault. | FTTI: 15 ms | Safe State: Secondary redundant motor takes over 100% rack steering control without interruption; limit maximum vehicle speed to 80 km/h..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-CHS-02)

##### `SYS-CHS-02-01`: Triple-Redundant Handwheel Angle Acquisition & 2oo3 Voting [ASIL D] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Triple-Redundant Handwheel Angle Acquisition & 2oo3 Voting across galvanically isolated channels.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: Sample rate 1000 Hz | Safe State: Secondary redundant motor takes over or graceful safe-stop executed.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate channel within FTTI and log DEM diagnostic trouble code.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-02-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-02_SbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-02-01), [`SWR-CHS-02-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-02_SbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-02-02), [`SWR-CHS-02-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-02_SbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-02-03)
