### FEAT-CHS-03: Electro-Hydraulic Brake-by-Wire Deceleration (BbW)
- **Domain:** Vehicle Motion & Chassis Control | **Target ASIL:** ASIL D
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Decoupled integrated brake-by-wire system (One-Box / Two-Box) providing pedal feel emulation and ultra-fast active brake pressure buildup (< 150 ms to 100 bar).
- **Activation Logic:** Dual hydraulic circuits pressurized, dual ECU power domains healthy, fluid reservoir level normal. Entry: Driver applies brake pedal OR autonomous ADAS function (AEB/ACC) requests deceleration.. Deactivation: Pedal released, autonomous request zero, pressure vented to reservoir.. Override: Complete electrical power failure opens mechanical push-through valves, enabling direct driver leg-power hydraulic braking adhering to ECE R13H..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-BBW-01: Guarantee vehicle stopping capability under any single electrical or hydraulic failure; maintain pedal deceleration feel. | FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Open mechanical push-through isolation valve; allow driver mechanical pedal pressure to reach front calipers directly..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-CHS-03)

##### `SYS-CHS-03-01`: Brake Pedal Stroke Emulation & Deceleration Intent Mapping [ASIL D] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL measure brake pedal travel stroke (< 0.1 mm resolution) and pedal force via dual redundant sensors at <= 2 ms period, mapping driver input into target vehicle deceleration (up to -1.0 g) with < 10 ms latency.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Revert to hydraulic push-through backup mode.
- **Failure Reaction:** If travel sensor channels disagree by > 2.0 mm, switch to pedal force hydraulic pressure backup sensor.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-03-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-01), [`SWR-CHS-03-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-02)

##### `SYS-CHS-03-02`: Electric Plunger High-Speed Hydraulic Pressure Regulation [ASIL D] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL drive a brushless electric plunger pump to generate hydraulic pressure from 0 to 100 bar in <= 150 ms with +-1.5 bar steady-state precision, distributing pressure to four calipers.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: De-energize plunger motor; open push-through backup valves.
- **Failure Reaction:** If plunger jams, trigger secondary electronic brake booster channel.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-03-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-03), [`SWR-CHS-03-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-04)

##### `SYS-CHS-03-03`: Decoupled Hydraulic Pedal Feel Emulator & Force-Travel Curve [ASIL D] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL decouple brake pedal mechanically from wheel calipers in normal mode: Driving a spring-loaded hydraulic simulator cylinder to deliver progressive non-linear pedal feel (0 to 60 mm travel with 500 N force @ 60 mm) independent of regenerative braking.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Open mechanical bypass valve; couple pedal directly to master cylinder (100% passive fallback).
- **Failure Reaction:** If pedal emulator valve leaks, open fallback bypass in <= 20 ms.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-03-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-05), [`SWR-CHS-03-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-06)

##### `SYS-CHS-03-04`: Passive Mechanical Fallback Hydraulic Valve & Dual Circuit Isolation [ASIL D] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL feature normally-open spring-return hydraulic isolation valves: Upon complete electrical power loss (12V cut) or dual micro crash, valves SHALL de-energize within <= 15 ms, reconnecting driver pedal mechanically to front wheel calipers to guarantee >= 0.44g deceleration (ECE R13H fallback requirement).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 15 ms | Safe State: Mechanical hydraulic circuit closed; zero electronics required for braking.
- **Failure Reaction:** Maintain manual brake pass-through if primary boost cylinder fails.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-03-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-07), [`SWR-CHS-03-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-08)

##### `SYS-CHS-03-05`: Dual Redundant Hydraulic Circuit Pressure Transducer Cross-Monitor [ASIL D] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Cross-check primary and secondary circuit pressure sensors: If discrepancy > 4.0 bar, isolate affected circuit.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-03-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-09), [`SWR-CHS-03-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-10)

##### `SYS-CHS-03-06`: Electric Brake Plunger Motor Hall & Resolver Angle Decoupled Decoder [ASIL D] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Decode high-speed motor position to regulate electric plunger displacement with precision +-0.05 mm.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 1 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-03-11`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-11), [`SWR-CHS-03-12`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-12)

##### `SYS-CHS-03-07`: Decoupled Brake Pedal Force-Displacement Active Hysteresis Shaper [ASIL D] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Modulate pedal feel simulator hydraulic orifice valve to create 15% tactile return hysteresis.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-03-13`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-13), [`SWR-CHS-03-14`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-14)

##### `SYS-CHS-03-08`: Foundation Caliper Pad Knock-Back Clearance Active Eliminator [ASIL D] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Pulse 2.5 bar hydraulic pressure following severe cornering to restore zero pad-to-rotor clearance gap.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-03-15`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-15), [`SWR-CHS-03-16`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-16)

##### `SYS-CHS-03-09`: Brake Fluid Vaporization & Temperature Dependent Pressure Compensator [ASIL D] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Increase plunger stroke target if brake fluid boiling point degradation or seal compliance expands.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-03-17`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-17), [`SWR-CHS-03-18`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-18)

##### `SYS-CHS-03-10`: Passive Hydraulic Mechanical Push-Through Solenoid Power Cut Safing [ASIL D] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL De-energize normally-open separation valves in <= 15 ms upon complete power loss, enabling manual braking.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 5 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-03-19`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-19), [`SWR-CHS-03-20`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-20)

##### `SYS-CHS-03-11`: Brake Fluid Low Level Reservoir Reed Switch Debouncer & Warning Gate [ASIL B] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Debounce fluid level sensor to illuminate master brake warning tell-tale before air enters master cylinder.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-03-21`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-21), [`SWR-CHS-03-22`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-22)

##### `SYS-CHS-03-12`: Dynamic Electronic Brake Proportioning (EBD) Under Variable Payloads [ASIL D] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Modulate front/rear caliper pressure ratio based on axle load cells and deceleration gradient.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-03-23`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-23), [`SWR-CHS-03-24`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-24)

##### `SYS-CHS-03-13`: Secondary Brake Boost Redundant Channel Autonomous Takeover Engine [ASIL D] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Ramp secondary electronic brake booster channel to 100% capacity in <= 20 ms if primary channel faults.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-03-25`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-25), [`SWR-CHS-03-26`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-26)

##### `SYS-CHS-03-14`: Dual Core Lockstep CPU Execution Flow & Watchdog Supervisor [ASIL D] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Execute cyclic challenge-response with external watchdog ASIC; reset and cut valves upon execution crash.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 2 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-03-27`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-27), [`SWR-CHS-03-28`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-28)

##### `SYS-CHS-03-15`: DEM Brake System Hydraulic Leakage Diagnostics & Freeze-Frame Storage [ASIL D] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Detect caliper circuit fluid leak by monitoring plunger volume vs pressure buildup; latch DTC C1102.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-03-29`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-29), [`SWR-CHS-03-30`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-30)

##### `SYS-CHS-03-16`: Non-Volatile Brake Service Duty Cycles & Caliper Wear Buffer [ASIL B] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Log lifetime brake applications, maximum peak pressures, and thermal exposure in non-volatile flash.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 1000 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-03-31`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-31), [`SWR-CHS-03-32`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-03_BbW_SwReq.md#swr-chs-03-32)

### FEAT-CHS-04: Electronic Continuous Damping Control & Active Suspension (EDC)
- **Domain:** Vehicle Motion & Chassis Control | **Target ASIL:** ASIL C
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Continuously adjusts semi-active damper solenoid valve currents at 100 Hz to isolate road vibrations (Skyhook algorithm) and eliminate pitch and roll body motions.
- **Activation Logic:** 12V power supply healthy, 4 wheel displacement sensors calibrated, vehicle moving. Entry: Vehicle speed > 2 km/h; driver selects drive mode (Comfort, Normal, Sport).. Deactivation: Vehicle parked in PARK with ignition OFF.. Override: Sudden aggressive steering input (> 100 deg/s) instantly forces dampers to maximum firm setting in < 15 ms to suppress body roll..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-EDC-01: Maintain tire-to-road contact; prevent suspension bottoming out or unstable body roll oscillations. | FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: De-energize all damper solenoids to passive mid-firm default damping setting..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-CHS-04)

##### `SYS-CHS-04-01`: Chassis Body Acceleration & Wheel Kinematic Acquisition [ASIL C] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL sample 3 vertical body accelerometers and 4 corner suspension height sensors at >= 100 Hz, calculating chassis heave, pitch, and roll rates at <= 10 ms period.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Zero body motion velocity estimates; suspend Skyhook control.
- **Failure Reaction:** If vertical accelerometer saturates, clamp reading to physical bump-stop limit.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-04-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-01), [`SWR-CHS-04-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-02)

##### `SYS-CHS-04-02`: Skyhook/Groundhook Damping Current Modulation [ASIL C] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL modulate PWM current (0.2A to 1.8A) through four continuously variable proportional damper valves in <= 15 ms, altering damping force between 500 N and 5000 N per corner.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 30 ms | Safe State: Set valve current to 0.0 A (mechanical default fail-safe damping).
- **Failure Reaction:** If solenoid driver reports thermal overload, reduce current by 30%.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-04-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-03), [`SWR-CHS-04-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-04)

##### `SYS-CHS-04-03`: Chassis 3D Rigid Body Modal Motion Observer (Heave, Pitch, Roll) [ASIL C] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Synthesize rigid body heave velocity, pitch rate, and roll rate from 3 body accelerometers and 4 height sensors.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-04-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-05), [`SWR-CHS-04-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-06)

##### `SYS-CHS-04-04`: Skyhook Body Inertial Damping Continuously Variable Force Generator [ASIL C] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Compute Skyhook damping force: F_sky = -C_sky * V_body_vertical, isolating cabin from road surface inputs.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-04-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-07), [`SWR-CHS-04-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-08)

##### `SYS-CHS-04-05`: Groundhook Wheel Unsprung Mass Hop & Tire Grip Optimizer [ASIL C] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Modulate damper force at wheel hop resonance (10-14 Hz) to maximize continuous tire-to-road contact.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-04-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-09), [`SWR-CHS-04-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-10)

##### `SYS-CHS-04-06`: Aggressive Steering Angle Anticipatory Anti-Roll Stiffness Booster [ASIL C] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Ramp corner dampers to maximum rebound/compression in <= 15 ms upon fast steering inputs (> 120 °/s).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-04-11`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-11), [`SWR-CHS-04-12`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-12)

##### `SYS-CHS-04-07`: Panic Braking Anti-Dive & Hard Acceleration Anti-Squat Pitch Regulator [ASIL C] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Stiffen front dampers during braking and rear dampers during acceleration to minimize body pitch.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-04-13`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-13), [`SWR-CHS-04-14`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-14)

##### `SYS-CHS-04-08`: Road Roughness Pothole Impact Fast Pressure Relief Protection [ASIL C] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Detect severe wheel impact acceleration (> 30 m/s²) and soften damper in < 8 ms to protect strut mounts.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 5 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-04-15`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-15), [`SWR-CHS-04-16`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-16)

##### `SYS-CHS-04-09`: Proportional Hydraulic Damper Solenoid PWM Current Closed-Loop Driver [ASIL C] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Regulate solenoid coil current between 0.2A and 1.8A with current tracking error <= 15 mA.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 2 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-04-17`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-17), [`SWR-CHS-04-18`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-18)

##### `SYS-CHS-04-10`: Corner Damper Solenoid Coil Multi-Point Thermal Protection Derater [ASIL B] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Derate continuous coil current if coil temperature exceeds 120 °C to prevent thermal insulation breakdown.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-04-19`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-19), [`SWR-CHS-04-20`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-20)

##### `SYS-CHS-04-11`: Suspension Deflection Height Sensor Plausibility & Geometry Cross-Check [ASIL C] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Verify height sensors against kinematic planar chassis geometry: Flag sensor drift if discrepancy > 8.0 mm.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-04-21`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-21), [`SWR-CHS-04-22`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-22)

##### `SYS-CHS-04-12`: Fail-Safe Passive Mid-Firm Default Mechanical Hydraulic Fallback Mode [ASIL C] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL De-energize all 4 damper solenoids to 0.0A upon electrical fault, locking dampers in safe mid-firm baseline.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-04-23`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-23), [`SWR-CHS-04-24`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-24)

##### `SYS-CHS-04-13`: DEM Suspension Damping Fault Diagnostics & Valve Open/Short Detector [ASIL B] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Qualify diagnostic trouble codes for coil open-circuit or height sensor linkage disconnection.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-04-25`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-25), [`SWR-CHS-04-26`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-26)

##### `SYS-CHS-04-14`: Driver Drive Mode Selection (Comfort, Standard, Sport) Characteristic Tuner [ASIL B] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Interpolate 3D damper force-velocity lookup tables according to active cabin drive mode switch.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-04-27`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-27), [`SWR-CHS-04-28`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-28)

##### `SYS-CHS-04-15`: Non-Volatile Damper Cumulative Energy Dissipation & Wear Life Monitor [ASIL B] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Integrate damper work done over time to predict shock absorber seal wear and fluid degradation.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 1000 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-04-29`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-29), [`SWR-CHS-04-30`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-04_EDC_SwReq.md#swr-chs-04-30)

### FEAT-CHS-05: Electronic Torque Vectoring & All-Wheel Drive (e-AWD)
- **Domain:** Vehicle Motion & Chassis Control | **Target ASIL:** ASIL D
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-CHS-05_eAWD_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-CHS-05_eAWD_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-CHS-05_eAWD_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-05_eAWD_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Coordinates dual/tri-motor electric drivetrains to distribute independent drive/regen torque between front and rear axles and left/right wheels to optimize agility and traction.
- **Activation Logic:** Both front and rear inverters operational, high-voltage battery ready, steering and yaw sensors healthy. Entry: Vehicle moving in D or R mode.. Deactivation: Transmission shifted to P or N, or critical failure on both axles.. Override: ESC stability intervention overrides torque vectoring, prioritizing yaw stabilization over cornering agility..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-AWD-01: Prevent unintended yaw moment generation; ensure torque vectoring cannot induce vehicle spin-out. | FTTI: 40 ms | Safe State: Equalize left/right wheel torques; fallback to symmetric front/rear axle torque distribution..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-CHS-05)

##### `SYS-CHS-05-01`: Front-to-Rear Dynamic Axle Torque Allocation [ASIL D] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL dynamically split total driver torque between front and rear axles (from 100:0 to 0:100) based on dynamic axle load transfer, wheel slip, and drive mode at <= 10 ms period.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Default to fixed 50:50 torque split or single-axle propulsion.
- **Failure Reaction:** If rear motor overtemperature trips, command 100% torque to front axle.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-05-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-05_eAWD_SwReq.md#swr-chs-05-01), [`SWR-CHS-05-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-05_eAWD_SwReq.md#swr-chs-05-02)

##### `SYS-CHS-05-02`: Lateral Left-Right Direct Yaw Moment Vectoring [ASIL D] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL apply differential torque (up to +-1200 Nm delta between left and right wheels) during cornering to generate active yaw moment, reducing understeer while verifying stability.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 40 ms | Safe State: Zero delta torque between left and right wheels (T_left = T_right).
- **Failure Reaction:** If yaw rate error deviates from linear stability limit, terminate torque vectoring.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-05-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-05_eAWD_SwReq.md#swr-chs-05-03), [`SWR-CHS-05-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-05_eAWD_SwReq.md#swr-chs-05-04)

##### `SYS-CHS-05-03`: Multi-Motor Dual-Axle Real-Time Yaw Disturbance Moment Calculator [ASIL D] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Compute required stabilizing yaw moment: M_z = C_yaw * (Psi_dot_actual - Psi_dot_target) at 100 Hz.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-05-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-05_eAWD_SwReq.md#swr-chs-05-05), [`SWR-CHS-05-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-05_eAWD_SwReq.md#swr-chs-05-06)

##### `SYS-CHS-05-04`: Individual Left/Right Wheel Independent Torque Allocation Engine [ASIL D] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Distribute positive drive torque to outer wheel and regenerative braking to inner wheel during cornering.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-05-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-05_eAWD_SwReq.md#swr-chs-05-07), [`SWR-CHS-05-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-05_eAWD_SwReq.md#swr-chs-05-08)

##### `SYS-CHS-05-05`: Tire Longitudinal & Lateral Friction Adhesion Circle G-G Diagram Observer [ASIL D] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Estimate tire grip capacity via friction ellipse, ensuring torque vectoring does not exceed peak traction.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-05-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-05_eAWD_SwReq.md#swr-chs-05-09), [`SWR-CHS-05-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-05_eAWD_SwReq.md#swr-chs-05-10)

##### `SYS-CHS-05-06`: Front/Rear Axle High-Speed Planetary Torque Split Dynamic Regulator [ASIL D] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Vary front-to-rear torque split continuously between 100:0 (FWD efficiency) and 20:80 (RWD dynamics).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-05-11`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-05_eAWD_SwReq.md#swr-chs-05-11), [`SWR-CHS-05-12`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-05_eAWD_SwReq.md#swr-chs-05-12)

##### `SYS-CHS-05-07`: Low-Friction Surface Split-Mu Cross-Axle Dynamic Slip Limiter [ASIL D] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Limit cross-axle wheel speed differential when one wheel encounters ice or snow, simulating locked diff.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-05-13`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-05_eAWD_SwReq.md#swr-chs-05-13), [`SWR-CHS-05-14`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-05_eAWD_SwReq.md#swr-chs-05-14)

##### `SYS-CHS-05-08`: High-Speed Understeer Neutralization & Corner Apex Pull-In Commander [ASIL D] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Increase outer-rear motor torque by up to +180 Nm to tuck vehicle nose into high-speed corner apexes.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-05-15`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-05_eAWD_SwReq.md#swr-chs-05-15), [`SWR-CHS-05-16`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-05_eAWD_SwReq.md#swr-chs-05-16)

##### `SYS-CHS-05-09`: Oversteer Dynamic Counter-Torque Yaw Dampening Stabilization Loop [ASIL D] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Reduce outer rear wheel torque and apply forward torque to outer front wheel to catch oversteer slides.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-05-17`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-05_eAWD_SwReq.md#swr-chs-05-17), [`SWR-CHS-05-18`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-05_eAWD_SwReq.md#swr-chs-05-18)

##### `SYS-CHS-05-10`: Multi-Inverter Coordinated CAN-FD Fast Command Dispatcher with E2E CRC [ASIL D] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Broadcast synchronized torque requests to 4 independent corner inverters with alive counter and CRC.

- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-05-19`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-05_eAWD_SwReq.md#swr-chs-05-19), [`SWR-CHS-05-20`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-05_eAWD_SwReq.md#swr-chs-05-20)

##### `SYS-CHS-05-11`: Inverter Fast Single-Wheel Cutoff & Symmetrical Neutral Fallback Safing [ASIL D] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Isolate faulted corner motor within <= 8 ms, zeroing opposite motor vectoring to prevent uncommanded yaw.

- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-05-21`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-05_eAWD_SwReq.md#swr-chs-05-21), [`SWR-CHS-05-22`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-05_eAWD_SwReq.md#swr-chs-05-22)

### FEAT-CHS-06: Electronic Air Suspension with Road Preview (EAS)
- **Domain:** Vehicle Motion & Chassis Control | **Target ASIL:** ASIL C
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-CHS-06_EAS_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-CHS-06_EAS_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-CHS-06_EAS_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-06_EAS_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Multi-chamber closed-loop air suspension with ride height adjustment (-40 mm to +60 mm), aerodynamic lowering, cross-articulation leveling, and forward camera preview damping adaptation.
- **Activation Logic:** 12V system voltage >= 11.5V, air reservoir pressure >= 9.0 bar, all 4 corner height sensors calibrated, tailgate and doors closed. Entry: Ignition in RUN, vehicle speed within operational range (-40 mm mode enabled at > 110 km/h; +60 mm off-road mode enabled at < 35 km/h).. Deactivation: Door or trunk opened during height transition (pinch hazard prevention), or reservoir pressure below 5.5 bar.. Override: Driver manual height rocker switch overrides auto-leveling within valid speed envelopes; opening any door immediately freezes solenoid valves in < 20 ms..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-EAS-01: Prevent asymmetric vehicle tilt > 3.0 degrees during high-speed travel (> 80 km/h); prevent uncommanded collapse of spring bellows. | FTTI: 80 ms for asymmetric valve opening; 200 ms for level regulation. | Safe State: Lock all 4 corner air solenoid valves into pneumatic closed position; suspend compressor operation..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-CHS-06)

##### `SYS-CHS-06-01`: Quad-Corner Ride Height Estimation & Target Levelling Control [ASIL C] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL sample 4 inductive suspension height sensors at 100 Hz, compute pitch and roll angles within +-0.1 deg, and command high-speed pneumatic solenoid valves to achieve target ride height (+-3 mm) in <= 15 seconds.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 80 ms | Safe State: De-energize all 4 corner solenoid valves into spring-return closed state.
- **Failure Reaction:** If any single height sensor fails, use pitch/roll estimation from chassis IMU to maintain degraded static leveling.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-06-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-06_EAS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-06-01), [`SWR-CHS-06-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-06_EAS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-06-02)

##### `SYS-CHS-06-02`: Stereo Vision Road Surface Preview & Active Pre-Filling [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL ingest forward stereo camera road profile 3D elevation maps (up to 15 m ahead) and proactively modulate air spring volume in <= 40 ms prior to speed bumps or pothole impacts to reduce vertical chassis acceleration by >= 45%.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Revert to standard passive damping and baseline pneumatic stiffness.
- **Failure Reaction:** If camera confidence drops due to rain/fog, gracefully fade out preview mode over 500 ms.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-06-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-06_EAS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-06-03), [`SWR-CHS-06-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-06_EAS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-06-04)

##### `SYS-CHS-06-03`: Chassis Ride Height Multi-Corner Closed-Loop Leveling Regulator [ASIL C] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Maintain target suspension ride height across all 4 air springs with steady-state precision +-2.0 mm.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-06-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-06_EAS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-06-05), [`SWR-CHS-06-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-06_EAS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-06-06)

##### `SYS-CHS-06-04`: Forward Road Preview Stereo Camera Pothole & Bump Active Adjuster [ASIL C] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Pre-adjust air spring volume 150 ms ahead of upcoming road speed bumps detected by vision preview.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 30 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-06-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-06_EAS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-06-07), [`SWR-CHS-06-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-06_EAS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-06-08)

##### `SYS-CHS-06-05`: Vehicle Speed-Dependent Aerodynamic Ride Height Lowering Scheduler [ASIL C] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Lower vehicle chassis height by 20 mm at speeds > 120 km/h to reduce aerodynamic drag coefficient by 4%.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-06-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-06_EAS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-06-09), [`SWR-CHS-06-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-06_EAS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-06-10)

##### `SYS-CHS-06-06`: Pneumatic Air Compressor High-Pressure Reservoir Pressure Servoloop [ASIL C] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Operate electric air compressor (up to 16.0 bar) to recharge high-pressure air reservoir tank.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-06-11`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-06_EAS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-06-11), [`SWR-CHS-06-12`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-06_EAS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-06-12)

##### `SYS-CHS-06-07`: Multi-Channel Solenoid Valve Block Cross-Corner Inflation Governor [ASIL C] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Pulse individual corner air spring solenoid valves with PWM duty cycles to adjust corner height.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-06-13`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-06_EAS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-06-13), [`SWR-CHS-06-14`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-06_EAS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-06-14)

##### `SYS-CHS-06-08`: Passenger & Luggage Variable Payload Ingress/Egress Static Leveler [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Level chassis automatically when passengers enter/exit or heavy luggage is placed in the rear cargo trunk.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 200 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.

##### `SYS-CHS-06-09`: Terrain Drive Mode Selection (Off-Road High, Standard, Access Low) Manager [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Transition chassis ground clearance across +50 mm (Off-Road), 0 mm (Standard), and -40 mm (Access mode).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.

##### `SYS-CHS-06-10`: Air Compressor Thermal Protection Temperature Sensor & Duty Cycle Guard [ASIL B] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Halt compressor pumping if compressor cylinder head temperature exceeds 125 °C to prevent seal burnout.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.

### FEAT-CHS-07: Rear-Wheel Steering with Co/Counter Steer (RWS)
- **Domain:** Vehicle Motion & Chassis Control | **Target ASIL:** ASIL D
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Dual-actuator rear-axle kinematic steering system providing up to +-10.0 degrees of rear wheel angle, executing low-speed counter-steering to slash turning circle and high-speed co-steering for lane-change yaw stability.
- **Activation Logic:** Dual redundant 12V power channels healthy, rear rack zero-center position calibrated, no active ABS/ESC fault. Entry: Ignition in RUN, vehicle moving in forward or reverse at speeds between 0 and 250 km/h.. Deactivation: Actuator critical fault, dual power loss, or crash pyro trigger received.. Override: Rear steering angle demand is autonomously computed from front steering angle and vehicle velocity; driver can select 'Agile' or 'Comfort' dynamic mapping profiles..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-RWS-01: Prevent uncommanded asymmetric rear wheel steer > 0.5 degrees at speeds > 60 km/h; prevent sudden lockup in full counter-steer at highway speeds. | FTTI: 25 ms | Safe State: De-energize rear steering BLDC motors; engage mechanical spring-loaded centering lock pin to lock rear wheels at 0.0 degrees..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-CHS-07)

##### `SYS-CHS-07-01`: Vehicle Speed Dependent Ackermann Rear-Wheel Angle Computation [ASIL D] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL compute target rear-wheel steering angle delta_r based on front steering angle delta_f and vehicle velocity v: Low speeds (< 50 km/h) counter-steer up to -10.0 deg; High speeds (> 70 km/h) co-steer up to +3.5 deg, with smooth linear interpolation through zero-transition zone (50-70 km/h) at <= 10 ms period.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 25 ms | Safe State: Command target rear wheel angle to 0.0 degrees at controlled ramp rate (1.0 deg/s).
- **Failure Reaction:** If vehicle speed signal is lost or untrusted, default to 0.0 degrees rear steering angle.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-07-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-01), [`SWR-CHS-07-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-02)

##### `SYS-CHS-07-02`: Dual-Redundant Rear Actuator Closed-Loop Angle Tracking & Mechanical Lock [ASIL D] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL control dual brushless DC rack actuators to track target rear steering angle within +-0.1 deg accuracy and angular velocity up to 25 deg/s, engaging mechanical center-lock pin upon electrical fault in <= 50 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 25 ms | Safe State: Fire solenoid to drive mechanical centering wedge into rear tie rod rack.
- **Failure Reaction:** If single motor phase opens, run secondary actuator channel at 50% max torque.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-07-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-03), [`SWR-CHS-07-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-04)

##### `SYS-CHS-07-03`: Rear-Wheel Steering Low-Speed Counter-Phase Agility Angle Calculator [ASIL D] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Compute counter-phase rear wheel steering angle (up to -8.0° opposite to front wheels) at speeds < 40 km/h.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-07-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-05), [`SWR-CHS-07-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-06)

##### `SYS-CHS-07-04`: High-Speed Co-Phase Directional Stability Rear Steering Angle Calculator [ASIL D] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Compute co-phase rear wheel steering angle (up to +3.5° matching front wheels) at speeds > 70 km/h.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-07-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-07), [`SWR-CHS-07-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-08)

##### `SYS-CHS-07-05`: Zero-Yaw Dynamic Crab Angle & Lateral Lane Change Transition Law [ASIL D] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Synthesize co-phase steering angle to allow lateral lane translation with zero vehicle body yaw rotation.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-07-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-09), [`SWR-CHS-07-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-10)

##### `SYS-CHS-07-06`: Rear Steering Electromechanical Linear Actuator Closed-Loop Position Servo [ASIL D] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Drive brushless motor actuator to position rear toe links with positional accuracy <= 0.05°.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 2 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-07-11`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-11), [`SWR-CHS-07-12`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-12)

##### `SYS-CHS-07-07`: Dual Redundant Hall/Resolver Rear Toe-Angle Sensor Cross-Monitor [ASIL D] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Cross-check dual independent rear wheel angle sensors: Trip fault if discrepancy > 0.20° roadwheel angle.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 2 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-07-13`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-13), [`SWR-CHS-07-14`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-14)

##### `SYS-CHS-07-08`: Dual-Inverter Symmetrical Motor Winding Load Sharing Controller [ASIL D] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Partition demanded rear steering force 50/50 across dual independent inverter channels.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 2 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-07-15`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-15), [`SWR-CHS-07-16`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-16)

##### `SYS-CHS-07-09`: Single-Channel Fault Autonomous 100% Load Takeover in <= 5 ms [ASIL D] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Ramp healthy inverter to full power in <= 5 ms if one winding bridge reports electrical fault.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 5 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-07-17`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-17), [`SWR-CHS-07-18`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-18)

##### `SYS-CHS-07-10`: Rear Mechanical Spring-Loaded Center-Lock Fallback Mechanism [ASIL D] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL De-energize electromagnetic brake to allow mechanical centering spring to lock rear wheels at 0.0° in <= 50 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-07-19`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-19), [`SWR-CHS-07-20`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-20)

##### `SYS-CHS-07-11`: ESC Stability Override & Rear-Axle Active Counter-Steer Yaw Damper [ASIL D] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Apply up to +-2.5° fast rear counter-steer in <= 30 ms to stabilize split-mu braking or oversteer slides.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 5 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-07-21`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-21), [`SWR-CHS-07-22`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-22)

##### `SYS-CHS-07-12`: Rear Wheel Tire Kinematic Clearance & Suspension Bump Envelope Guard [ASIL D] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Clamp maximum rear steering angle as suspension compresses to prevent tire rubbing wheel arch liners.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-07-23`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-23), [`SWR-CHS-07-24`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-24)

##### `SYS-CHS-07-13`: Actuator Thermal Overload & Continuous High-Load Torque Derater [ASIL B] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Derate maximum rear steering rate if motor winding temperature exceeds 135 °C during repeated slaloms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-07-25`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-25), [`SWR-CHS-07-26`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-26)

##### `SYS-CHS-07-14`: Dual Core Lockstep Microcontroller Safety Gatekeeper & Token Validator [ASIL D] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Verify execution tokens between Core 0 and Core 1; fire center-lock pin upon computation disagreement.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 2 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-07-27`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-27), [`SWR-CHS-07-28`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-28)

##### `SYS-CHS-07-15`: DEM Rear-Wheel Steering Diagnostic Event Manager & DTC Logger [ASIL D] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Qualify diagnostic fault codes for actuator jam, resolver error, and mechanical center-lock failures.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-07-29`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-29), [`SWR-CHS-07-30`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-07_RWS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-07-30)

##### `SYS-CHS-07-16`: Instrument Cluster Rear-Wheel Steering Health Status & Turning Radius HMI [ASIL B] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Transmit RWS operational status, turning circle animation, and warning messages to cluster display.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.

### FEAT-CHS-08: Electronic Active Roll Stabilization (e-ARS)
- **Domain:** Vehicle Motion & Chassis Control | **Target ASIL:** ASIL C
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-CHS-08_e-ARS_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-CHS-08_e-ARS_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-CHS-08_e-ARS_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-08_e-ARS_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** High-dynamic electromechanical anti-roll bars front and rear powered by 48V / HV motors, decoupling suspension in straight-line driving for supple ride comfort while delivering up to 1400 Nm stabilizing torque to eliminate body roll in corners.
- **Activation Logic:** 48V DC-DC converter operational, front and rear actuator planetary gearboxes calibrated, chassis IMU calibrated. Entry: Ignition in RUN, vehicle speed > 15 km/h, lateral acceleration |a_y| > 0.5 m/s².. Deactivation: Vehicle stationary, or driver engages off-road rock crawling mode (full bar decoupling).. Override: Driver selection of 'Dynamic' mode stiffens roll response and induces neutral steering balance; 'Comfort' prioritizes single-wheel bump isolation..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-EARS-01: Prevent uncommanded asymmetric roll torque > 300 Nm in straight-line driving; avoid sudden roll torque inversion during sustained cornering. | FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Open motor winding relays; revert anti-roll bars to neutral passive torsional stiffness..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-CHS-08)

##### `SYS-CHS-08-01`: Chassis Lateral Dynamics Roll Moment Distribution Calculator [ASIL C] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL sample lateral acceleration, yaw rate, and steering angle at 100 Hz, calculating total vehicle roll moment demand and distributing torque between front axle (40-70%) and rear axle (30-60%) to suppress vehicle body roll angle to <= 1.5 deg up to 0.8g lateral acceleration.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 40 ms | Safe State: Zero active roll torque demand; revert to passive mechanical stiffness.
- **Failure Reaction:** If rear actuator faults, maintain front actuator at 50% torque to prevent oversteer instability.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-08-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-08_e-ARS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-08-01), [`SWR-CHS-08-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-08_e-ARS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-08-02)

##### `SYS-CHS-08-02`: 48V Electromechanical Actuator Planetary Geartrain Servo Control [ASIL C] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL drive front and rear 48V brushless servomotors through 1:120 planetary gearsets to deliver up to +-1400 Nm anti-roll torque with step response time <= 100 ms (0 to 90% peak torque).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: De-energize 48V inverter bridge; open phase isolation relays.
- **Failure Reaction:** If 48V supply voltage drops below 36V, limit peak current to 30A.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-08-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-08_e-ARS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-08-03), [`SWR-CHS-08-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-08_e-ARS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-08-04)

##### `SYS-CHS-08-03`: Chassis Dynamic Body Roll Moment Lateral Acceleration Observer [ASIL C] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Estimate overturning roll moment from lateral accelerometer, steering angle rate, and vehicle mass.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-08-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-08_e-ARS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-08-05), [`SWR-CHS-08-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-08_e-ARS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-08-06)

##### `SYS-CHS-08-04`: Active Anti-Roll Bar Front/Rear Dynamic Roll Stiffness Proportioner [ASIL C] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Distribute roll stiffness between front and rear axles to modulate understeer/oversteer handling balance.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-08-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-08_e-ARS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-08-07), [`SWR-CHS-08-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-08_e-ARS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-08-08)

##### `SYS-CHS-08-05`: High-Torque 48V Electromechanical Roll Actuator Closed-Loop Servo [ASIL C] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Drive front/rear 48V brushless stabilizer motor actuators to deliver up to 1200 Nm anti-roll torque.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 2 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CHS-08-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-08_e-ARS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-08-09), [`SWR-CHS-08-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CHS-08_e-ARS_SwReq.md#swr-chs-08-10)

##### `SYS-CHS-08-06`: Straight-Line Single-Wheel Roughness Decoupling & Ride Comfort Optimizer [ASIL C] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Decouple left and right anti-roll bar halves on straight bumpy roads to eliminate single-wheel head toss.

## Body, Lighting & Restraints

### FEAT-BDY-01: Passive Entry Passive Start & Digital Key (PEPS)
- **Domain:** Body, Lighting & Restraints | **Target ASIL:** ASIL B / ISO 21434
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-BDY-01_PEPS_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-BDY-01_PEPS_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-BDY-01_PEPS_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-01_PEPS_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Authenticates smartphone fobs and keyfobs via Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) and Ultra-Wideband (UWB) IEEE 802.15.4z secure ranging to enable hands-free entry and driveaway authorization.
- **Activation Logic:** 12V vehicle battery voltage >= 11.5V, UWB anchor transceiver network synchronized, BCM active. Entry: Authorized smartphone or keyfob enters exterior BLE advertising zone (< 15 m) and initiates UWB secure ranging (< 6 m).. Deactivation: Key moves outside 2.5 m perimeter for > 2.0s (walk-away lock), or vehicle start button pressed with key validated.. Override: Physical mechanical emergency key blade in driver door handle unlocks door mechanically in case of dead battery..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-PEPS-01: Prevent unauthorized vehicle unlock or motor startup; protect against relay station attacks. | FTTI: 200 ms for entry ranging; 50 ms for start button authorization. | Safe State: Lock doors; refuse start authorization token to powertrain VCU; lock electronic steering column..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-BDY-01)

##### `SYS-BDY-01-01`: IEEE 802.15.4z UWB Secure Time-of-Flight Multilateration [ASIL B / ISO 21434] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL compute keyfob 3D Cartesian coordinates relative to vehicle center with < 10 cm spatial accuracy using at least 4 UWB anchor transceivers at <= 50 ms period, verifying cryptographic STS tokens to prevent relay attacks.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Invalidate distance estimate; refuse unlock sequence.
- **Failure Reaction:** If distance measurement exhibits negative phase velocity (relay spoofing indicator), trip security lockout.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-01-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-01_PEPS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-01-01), [`SWR-BDY-01-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-01_PEPS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-01-02)

##### `SYS-BDY-01-02`: Zone State Automation & Cryptographic Immobilizer Handshake [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL command welcome puddle lights at < 3.0 m, door unlocking at < 1.5 m, walk-away lock at > 2.5 m, and execute an AES-128 challenge-response session to authorize vehicle powertrain start within <= 50 ms of Start Button press.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Withhold start authorization token from VCU; maintain immobilizer lock.
- **Failure Reaction:** If challenge-response token mismatch occurs, lock start button for 5.0 seconds.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-01-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-01_PEPS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-01-03), [`SWR-BDY-01-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-01_PEPS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-01-04)

##### `SYS-BDY-01-03`: IEEE 802.15.4z UWB Cryptographic Time-of-Flight Anti-Relay Bounding [ASIL B / ISO 21434] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL compute cryptographically authenticated Ultra-Wideband (UWB) Time-of-Flight distance (0 to 10 m with +-5 cm accuracy) using Scrambled Timestamp Sequence (STS) to prevent relay-station attacks.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Keep vehicle doors locked; prohibit engine/drive start.
- **Failure Reaction:** If UWB ranging timestamps show physical anomaly or phase variance, abort authentication.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-01-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-01_PEPS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-01-05), [`SWR-BDY-01-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-01_PEPS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-01-06)

##### `SYS-BDY-01-04`: Welcome Carpet Light Choreography & Walk-Away Auto-Lock [QM] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL orchestrate dynamic LED ground projection carpet lighting when key approaches within 3.0 m, and automatically lock all doors, close windows, fold mirrors, and arm alarm when key walks away (> 2.5 m for > 3.0s).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 200 ms | Safe State: Lock all doors; arm ultrasonic interior intrusion alarm.
- **Failure Reaction:** If key remains inside cabin, prohibit walk-away auto lock to prevent locking keys inside.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-01-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-01_PEPS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-01-07), [`SWR-BDY-01-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-01_PEPS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-01-08)

##### `SYS-BDY-01-05`: Ultra-Wideband (UWB) Time-of-Flight Decimeter-Level Distance Ranging [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Measure time-of-flight distance between vehicle transceivers and digital smartphone key with accuracy <= 10 cm.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-01-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-01_PEPS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-01-09), [`SWR-BDY-01-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-01_PEPS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-01-10)

##### `SYS-BDY-01-06`: Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) RSSI Distance Proximity Channel Initiator [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Detect approaching authorized smartphone key at 15 m distance to initiate wake-up lighting sequence.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-01-11`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-01_PEPS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-01-11), [`SWR-BDY-01-12`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-01_PEPS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-01-12)

##### `SYS-BDY-01-07`: Cryptographic Challenge-Response Rolling Code Anti-Relay Attack Validator [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Execute AES-128 cryptographic exchange with rolling counter: Invalidate key session if latency > 30 ms (relay attack).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-01-13`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-01_PEPS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-01-13), [`SWR-BDY-01-14`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-01_PEPS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-01-14)

##### `SYS-BDY-01-08`: Interior vs Exterior Transceiver Key Spatial Localization Classifier [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Distinguish whether authenticated key is inside or outside vehicle cabin to prevent uncommanded door lockouts.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-01-15`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-01_PEPS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-01-15), [`SWR-BDY-01-16`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-01_PEPS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-01-16)

##### `SYS-BDY-01-09`: Capacitive Door Handle Touch Sensor Approach & Grasp Debouncer [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Sample door handle capacitive sensors: Unlock door latch within <= 150 ms of driver grasp detection.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 30 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-01-17`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-01_PEPS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-01-17), [`SWR-BDY-01-18`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-01_PEPS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-01-18)
