### FEAT-BDY-02: Adaptive Driving Beam Matrix Headlights (ADB)
- **Domain:** Body, Lighting & Restraints | **Target ASIL:** ASIL B
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-BDY-02_ADB_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-BDY-02_ADB_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-BDY-02_ADB_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-02_ADB_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Dynamically carves out glare-free shadow masks around oncoming and leading vehicles using 84 to 1024 LED matrix pixels while maintaining high-beam road illumination elsewhere.
- **Activation Logic:** Vehicle light switch in AUTO, vehicle speed > 30 km/h, ambient light level < 300 lux (night-time). Entry: High-beam auto mode activated; forward camera detects target vehicles on road ahead.. Deactivation: Vehicle slows to < 20 km/h, high ambient street lighting detected (> 500 lux), or driver manually switches to low-beam.. Override: Driver flashing high-beam lever unconditionally commands 100% full high beam illumination..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-ADB-01: Prevent glare to other road users (illuminance at opposing driver eye point <= 1.0 lux) while maximizing driver night visibility. | FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Immediately switch all LED pixels to standard low-beam pattern..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-BDY-02)

##### `SYS-BDY-02-01`: Camera Object Azimuth Angle & Angular Width Tracking [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL compute the horizontal azimuth angle (+-30 deg) and angular bounding box width of all oncoming and leading vehicles with 0.2 deg precision at >= 30 Hz.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 80 ms | Safe State: Enforce standard low beam cut-off line.
- **Failure Reaction:** If target range is ambiguous, expand shadow mask width by +3.0 degrees safety buffer.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-02-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-02_ADB_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-02-01), [`SWR-BDY-02-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-02_ADB_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-02-02)

##### `SYS-BDY-02-02`: Individual LED Matrix Pixel PWM Duty Modulation & Slew Limiting [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL modulate current duty cycles across matrix LED pixels (84 to 1024 pixels per headlamp) without visible flicker (PWM frequency >= 1 kHz), transitioning pixels in <= 30 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Turn off high-beam matrix LED banks; retain standard low-beam projector.
- **Failure Reaction:** If matrix driver reports over-temperature (> 125°C), derate overall LED current by 40%.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-02-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-02_ADB_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-02-03), [`SWR-BDY-02-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-02_ADB_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-02-04)

##### `SYS-BDY-02-03`: Matrix LED Headlamp 84-Pixel Array Independent Dimming Controller [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Modulate PWM current to 84 independent micro-LED emitters to create dynamic shadow masks around vehicles.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-02-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-02_ADB_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-02-05), [`SWR-BDY-02-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-02_ADB_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-02-06)

##### `SYS-BDY-02-04`: Front Camera Oncoming & Preceding Vehicle Headlamp/Taillamp Tracker [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Track coordinates and light intensity of forward vehicles up to 400 m ahead at 30 fps frame rate.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 30 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-02-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-02_ADB_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-02-07), [`SWR-BDY-02-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-02_ADB_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-02-08)

##### `SYS-BDY-02-05`: High-Speed Dynamic Glare-Free Shadow Mask Polygon Generator [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Calculate spatial exclusion box around detected vehicles, dimming target LEDs to < 1.0 lux glare limit.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-02-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-02_ADB_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-02-09), [`SWR-BDY-02-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-02_ADB_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-02-10)

##### `SYS-BDY-02-06`: Vehicle Pitch Dynamic Leveling Sensor Axle Deflection Compensator [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Compensate headlight vertical aim angle based on front/rear axle ride height sensors to eliminate glare over crests.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.

##### `SYS-BDY-02-07`: Steering Angle Predictive Cornering Light Beam Swivel Commander [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Swivel auxiliary LED cornering light beams up to +-15° into upcoming turns based on steering wheel angle.

- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.

- **Statement:** The System SHALL Transition smoothly between low beam and matrix high beam when ambient illuminance drops below 10 lux.

### FEAT-BDY-03: Supplemental Restraint System & Airbag Deployment (SRS)
- **Domain:** Body, Lighting & Restraints | **Target ASIL:** ASIL D
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-BDY-03_SRS_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-BDY-03_SRS_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-BDY-03_SRS_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-03_SRS_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Processes high-G crash accelerometers and pressure sensors to trigger squib deployment of frontal airbags, side curtains, pretensioners, and high-voltage pyrofuses in <= 15 ms.
- **Activation Logic:** Ignition in RUN, airbag capacitor energy reserve charged (> 25V), occupant classification sensors healthy. Entry: Crash deceleration impulse delta_v exceeds calibrated deployment threshold.. Deactivation: Deployment squibs fired (permanent state) or power down.. Override: Passenger airbag manual disable switch (or baby seat detected) suppresses passenger frontal airbag deployment..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-SRS-01: Guarantee airbag squib deployment within 15 ms during severe crash; absolutely prevent inadvertent deployment during normal driving or pothole impacts. | FTTI: 5 ms | Safe State: Hardware arming safing sensor prevents firing unless independent mechanical/MEMS safing sensor confirms crash..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-BDY-03)

##### `SYS-BDY-03-01`: Dual-Axis Crash Pulse Integration & Velocity Change (Delta-V) Calculation [ASIL D] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL sample crash accelerometers (+-100g front, +-50g lateral, door cavity pressure) at 4 kHz (<= 0.25 ms), integrating deceleration into crash velocity change (Delta-V) and crash severity index within <= 10 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 2 ms | Safe State: Do not fire squibs; assert airbag warning lamp.
- **Failure Reaction:** If one crash sensor fails self-test, fallback to redundant centralized tunnel sensor.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-03-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-03_SRS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-03-01), [`SWR-BDY-03-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-03_SRS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-03-02)

##### `SYS-BDY-03-02`: Hardware Safing Interlock & Multi-Stage Squib Deployment [ASIL D] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL fire squib loops (driver/passenger frontal, curtain, knee, seatbelt pretensioners, HV pyrofuse) with firing current >= 1.75 A for >= 2.0 ms only when hardware safing sensor AND software algorithm agree within <= 2 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 2 ms | Safe State: Keep high-side squib drivers open.
- **Failure Reaction:** If squib loop resistance deviates outside [1.8, 2.5] ohms during self-test, report squib loop fault.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-03-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-03_SRS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-03-03), [`SWR-BDY-03-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-03_SRS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-03-04)

##### `SYS-BDY-03-03`: Multi-Axis Front, Side & Rollover Crash Severity Classification [ASIL D] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL sample central and satellite accelerometers at 4 kHz, evaluating Velocity Drop (Delta_V), Crash Energy Integral, and Roll Angular Momentum in <= 8 ms to classify crash severity tier (No-Fire, Stage 1 Low-Speed, Stage 2 High-Speed, Rollover).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 8 ms | Safe State: Inhibit pyrotechnic squib firing in low-severity impacts to avoid unnecessary repair costs.
- **Failure Reaction:** If satellite crash sensor communication drops, rely on central ECU dual-core accelerometers.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-03-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-03_SRS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-03-06), [`SWR-BDY-03-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-03_SRS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-03-07)

##### `SYS-BDY-03-04`: Dual-Stage Airbag Squib Firing Timing & Seatbelt Pretensioner Coordination [ASIL D] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL fire pyrotechnic seatbelt pretensioners in <= 12 ms, Stage 1 airbag squibs in <= 18 ms, and Stage 2 airbag squibs with variable delay (15 to 45 ms depending on crash severity and occupant position) to optimize occupant deceleration trajectory.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 2 ms for squib pulse generation. | Safe State: Open high-side and low-side firing transistors after 2.0 ms squib current pulse.
- **Failure Reaction:** If squib loop resistance is out of spec (< 1.5 ohm or > 5.5 ohm), log latched DTC B0001.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-03-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-03_SRS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-03-08), [`SWR-BDY-03-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-03_SRS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-03-09)

##### `SYS-BDY-03-05`: Occupant Classification Child-Seat Suppression & HV Pyrofuse Cut-Off [ASIL D] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL automatically suppress passenger frontal airbag if passenger seat is occupied by child safety seat (< 15 kg according to FMVSS 208), and transmit dedicated hardware discrete crash pulse to blow high-voltage traction pyrofuse in <= 2 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 2 ms for HV pyrofuse pulse. | Safe State: De-energize 400V/800V traction battery; turn on hazard lights and unlock doors.
- **Failure Reaction:** Default passenger airbag to ENABLED if occupant classification sensor is defective.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-03-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-03_SRS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-03-10), [`SWR-BDY-03-11`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-03_SRS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-03-11)

##### `SYS-BDY-03-06`: Central Crash Sensor 6-DOF IMU Accelerometer Longitudinal Impact Evaluator [ASIL D] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Sample central crash accelerometers at 2000 Hz, calculating crash velocity change Delta-V within 15 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 1 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-03-11`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-03_SRS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-03-11), [`SWR-BDY-03-12`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-03_SRS_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-03-12)

##### `SYS-BDY-03-07`: Front Bumper Left/Right Satellite Crash Accelerometer Cross-Checker [ASIL D] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Validate satellite crash sensor signals against central IMU to confirm genuine frontal barrier impact.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 1 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.

- **Statement:** The System SHALL Integrate door cavity air pressure pulse signals to detect T-bone side collisions within <= 8.0 ms.

- **Statement:** The System SHALL Fire Stage 1 squib (1.75 A for 2.0 ms) and Stage 2 squib timed 20-40 ms later based on crash severity.

### FEAT-BDY-04: Intelligent Multi-Zone HVAC & Cabin Air Quality (HVAC-AQ)
- **Domain:** Body, Lighting & Restraints | **Target ASIL:** ASIL A / QM
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-BDY-04_HVAC_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-BDY-04_HVAC_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-BDY-04_HVAC_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-04_HVAC_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Quad-zone climate comfort system integrating heat pump thermal expansion valves, solar radiation angle tracking, cabin PM2.5 laser scattering sensors, and high-voltage negative ion purification.
- **Activation Logic:** 12V system voltage >= 11.5V, High-Voltage traction battery connected (for 400V/800V electric A/C scroll compressor), cabin blower healthy. Entry: Ignition in RUN or pre-conditioning requested via smartphone telematics; AUTO climate mode engaged.. Deactivation: Driver presses OFF button, vehicle shutdown, or high-voltage battery SOC drops below 15% during remote preconditioning.. Override: Driver manual fan speed or vent position overrides AUTO mode for that zone; Windshield Defrost button unconditionally commands maximum heat and blower to windshield within 200 ms..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-HVAC-01: Ensure rapid windshield defrosting / defogging to guarantee driver forward field of view (ECE R43 / FMVSS 103); prevent refrigerant leaks into passenger compartment. | FTTI: 200 ms for defrost vent flap override; 1000 ms for refrigerant leak isolation. | Safe State: Force defrost vent flaps 100% open to windshield; command blower speed to 80%; isolate cabin refrigerant solenoid valve..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-BDY-04)

##### `SYS-BDY-04-01`: Quad-Zone Thermal Comfort Model & Solar Radiation Compensation [QM] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL sample 4 interior zone temperature thermistors, ambient temperature, vehicle velocity, and dual-zone solar elevation/azimuth pyranometer at 10 Hz, calculating required air discharge temperature (+-0.5°C) and blower air mass for each occupant zone.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 1000 ms | Safe State: Default to fixed 22.0°C discharge temperature and medium fan speed.
- **Failure Reaction:** If solar pyranometer fails, assume zero solar irradiation and rely on ambient sensor.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-04-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-04_HVAC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-04-01), [`SWR-BDY-04-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-04_HVAC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-04-02)

##### `SYS-BDY-04-02`: Laser PM2.5 / CO2 Cabin Air Quality Monitoring & Multi-Stage Ionization [ASIL A] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL sample cabin and ambient PM2.5 laser scattering sensors (0-500 ug/m³) and NDIR CO2 sensors (400-5000 ppm) at 1 Hz, automatically commanding motorized recirculation flap and high-voltage negative ion generator in <= 2.0 seconds when ambient pollution spikes.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 2000 ms | Safe State: Open fresh air flap to 25% minimum to prevent passenger drowsiness from CO2 buildup.
- **Failure Reaction:** If CO2 sensor reports > 2500 ppm, override recirculation mode and force 100% fresh air intake.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-04-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-04_HVAC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-04-03), [`SWR-BDY-04-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-04_HVAC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-04-04)

##### `SYS-BDY-04-03`: Cabin 4-Zone Temperature Setpoint & Solar Radiation Flux Balancer [ASIL A] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Balance climate setpoints across 4 independent cabin quadrants based on multi-zone solar radiation sensors.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 200 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-04-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-04_HVAC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-04-05), [`SWR-BDY-04-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-04_HVAC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-04-06)

##### `SYS-BDY-04-04`: Particulate Matter (PM2.5) & VOC Cabin Air Quality Sensor Observer [ASIL A] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Sample laser PM2.5 and metal-oxide VOC sensors; activate cabin air recirculation if PM2.5 > 35 µg/m³.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 500 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-04-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-04_HVAC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-04-07), [`SWR-BDY-04-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-04_HVAC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-04-08)

##### `SYS-BDY-04-05`: Automated Fresh Air / Recirculation Damper Stepper Motor Servocontrol [ASIL A] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Position motorized intake air flaps to switch between fresh air and high-efficiency HEPA recirculation.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-04-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-04_HVAC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-04-09), [`SWR-BDY-04-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-04_HVAC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-04-10)

##### `SYS-BDY-04-06`: Brushless Multi-Zone HVAC Blower Fan PWM Speed Governor [ASIL A] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Regulate 12V brushless blower motor speed via PWM across 7 discrete flow levels with soft-start ramp.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-04-11`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-04_HVAC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-04-11), [`SWR-BDY-04-12`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-04_HVAC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-04-12)

##### `SYS-BDY-04-07`: Air Distribution Face, Footwell & Defrost Flap Actuator Synchronizer [ASIL A] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Synchronize LIN bus stepper motor flap actuators to route airflow according to driver mode selection.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-04-13`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-04_HVAC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-04-13), [`SWR-BDY-04-14`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-04_HVAC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-04-14)

##### `SYS-BDY-04-08`: Windshield Humidity Sensor & Predictive Glass Defogging Governor [ASIL A] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Monitor windshield relative humidity: Turn on AC compressor and defrost vents before condensation forms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 200 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-04-15`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-04_HVAC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-04-15), [`SWR-BDY-04-16`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-04_HVAC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-04-16)

##### `SYS-BDY-04-09`: High-Voltage Cabin Air Electric Ionizer & Fragrance Dispenser Driver [ASIL A] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Control negative ion generator and motorized fragrance cartridge dispenser to purify cabin atmosphere.

### FEAT-BDY-05: Smart Power Closures with Anti-Pinch Protection (SPC)
- **Domain:** Body, Lighting & Restraints | **Target ASIL:** ASIL B / FMVSS 118
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Mechatronic closure orchestration for hands-free power tailgate, flush deployable door handles, and frameless power windows with optical and hall-effect anti-pinch safety reversal.
- **Activation Logic:** 12V auxiliary battery >= 11.8V, vehicle speed == 0 km/h (for tailgate / doors), vehicle gear in PARK. Entry: User triggers capacitive kick sensor, tailgate switch, key fob button, or vehicle approaches with authenticated digital key.. Deactivation: Vehicle shifted out of PARK, vehicle speed > 3 km/h, or closure cycle successfully cinched.. Override: Manual push/pull of door or tailgate during motorized motion immediately releases electromagnetic clutch to allow 100% manual effort..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-SPC-01: Prevent entrapment and crushing injuries; reverse motorized closing motion within 100 ms if obstacle resistance > 100 N detected (FMVSS 118 / ECE R21). | FTTI: 50 ms for pinch sensor strip; 100 ms for motor ripple anti-pinch detection. | Safe State: Immediately stop motor drive within 30 ms and reverse travel by >= 150 mm..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-BDY-05)

##### `SYS-BDY-05-01`: Capacitive Foot-Kick Gesture Recognition & Digital Key Verification [QM] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL sample dual capacitive kick sensing antennas under rear bumper at 50 Hz, validating forward-backward kicking gesture kinematics within 400 ms, while verifying authenticated digital key presence (< 1.2 m) before unlatching tailgate.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 200 ms | Safe State: Do not open tailgate; keep primary latch locked.
- **Failure Reaction:** Ignore capacitive signals if water puddles or heavy rain introduce continuous ground coupling.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-05-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-01), [`SWR-BDY-05-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-02)

##### `SYS-BDY-05-02`: Dual-Spindle Motor Velocity Profiling & Cinch Latch Actuation [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL synchronize dual electromechanical spindle actuators to open/close tailgate over 4.5 seconds following an S-curve acceleration profile, transitioning to electric cinch motor to pull latch into secondary striker in <= 1.0 second.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Reverse spindle motion by >= 150 mm; de-energize cinch puller.
- **Failure Reaction:** If cinch motor stalls before secondary striker engages, release cinch and latch warning.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-05-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-03), [`SWR-BDY-05-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-04)

##### `SYS-BDY-05-03`: Anti-Pinch Resistive Sensor & Motor Current Ripple Observer [ASIL B / FMVSS 118] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL monitor rubber contact pinch sensor strips (pressure drop < 1000 ohms) and sample motor current ripples at 1 kHz: If closing force exceeds 100 N at any point between 4 mm and 200 mm from seal, system SHALL reverse motion in <= 100 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Reverse motor direction to open tailgate by >= 150 mm within 100 ms.
- **Failure Reaction:** If pinch strip disconnects, latch DTC B12D4 and prohibit power close.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-05-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-05), [`SWR-BDY-05-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-06)

##### `SYS-BDY-05-04`: Power Liftgate & Window Dual Hall Sensor Position & Velocity Tracker [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Count magnetic Hall sensor quadrature pulses to determine closure glass/lid position and closing velocity.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 5 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-05-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-07), [`SWR-BDY-05-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-08)

##### `SYS-BDY-05-05`: FMVSS 118 Compliance Non-Reversal Anti-Pinch Force Observer [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Differentiate motor velocity: Detect pinch resistance force (> 100 N) and reverse motor in <= 50 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 5 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-05-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-09), [`SWR-BDY-05-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-10)

##### `SYS-BDY-05-06`: Optical Infrared & Capacitive Seal Contactless Obstacle Detector [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Detect human fingers approaching seal before physical contact, halting motor motion immediately.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-05-11`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-11), [`SWR-BDY-05-12`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-12)

##### `SYS-BDY-05-07`: Power Liftgate Spindle Drive DC Motor H-Bridge PWM Driver [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Control dual high-current H-bridge power stages driving spindle screw actuators with soft-stop ramping.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 5 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-05-13`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-13), [`SWR-BDY-05-14`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-14)

##### `SYS-BDY-05-08`: Automatic Power Cincher Latch Motor Pull-In Sequence Governor [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Engage motorized secondary latch cincher to pull liftgate or door from primary catch into full seal lock.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-05-15`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-15), [`SWR-BDY-05-16`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-16)

##### `SYS-BDY-05-09`: Vehicle Motion Interlock Speed Gatekeeper (Door/Trunk Lockout) [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Inhibit power door or liftgate opening commands whenever vehicle speed exceeds 3.0 km/h.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-05-17`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-17), [`SWR-BDY-05-18`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-18)

##### `SYS-BDY-05-10`: Tailgate Hands-Free Foot Kick Ultrasonic Sensor Gesture Recognizer [ASIL B] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Process rear bumper kick sensor signals to validate intentional opening kick gesture under tailgate.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-05-19`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-19), [`SWR-BDY-05-20`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-20)

##### `SYS-BDY-05-11`: Door Mechanical Resistance Wind Gust & Inclined Parking Gravity Compensator [ASIL B] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Adjust motor closing torque profile dynamically when vehicle is parked on steep grades or in high winds.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-05-21`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-21), [`SWR-BDY-05-22`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-22)

##### `SYS-BDY-05-12`: Power Closure DC Motor Thermal Overload Duty Cycle Guard [ASIL B] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Inhibit repeated power closure activations if motor internal temperature exceeds 110 °C.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-05-23`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-23), [`SWR-BDY-05-24`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-24)

##### `SYS-BDY-05-13`: Power Window Emergency Express-Up Window Closure Safe Stop Logic [ASIL B] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Halt one-touch express up window travel and reverse by 125 mm upon anti-pinch trigger.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-05-25`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-25), [`SWR-BDY-05-26`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-26)

##### `SYS-BDY-05-14`: DEM Power Closures Hall Sensor Fault Diagnostics & DTC Latcher [ASIL B] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Detect missing Hall pulses while motor current is flowing (stall condition) and log DTC B1025.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-05-27`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-27), [`SWR-BDY-05-28`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-28)

##### `SYS-BDY-05-15`: Acoustic Warning Chime & Exterior Lamp Flasher Annunciation Driver [ASIL A] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Sound exterior acoustic beeper and flash hazard lamps during automated liftgate opening/closing.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-05-29`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-29), [`SWR-BDY-05-30`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-05_SPC_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-05-30)

### FEAT-BDY-06: Dynamic Electrochromic Smart Glass Roof (EC-ROOF)
- **Domain:** Body, Lighting & Restraints | **Target ASIL:** ASIL A / QM
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-BDY-06_EC-ROOF_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-BDY-06_EC-ROOF_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-BDY-06_EC-ROOF_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-06_EC-ROOF_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Multi-segment SPD (Suspended Particle Device) and electrochromic panoramic glass roof control with variable optical transmittance (0.5% to 55%), segmented privacy zoning, and UV/IR heat rejection management.
- **Activation Logic:** 12V system voltage >= 11.5V, high-voltage AC inverter for smart glass operational, roof glass controller initialized. Entry: Ignition in RUN or pre-conditioning mode active; occupant selects tint level via overhead slider or infotainment.. Deactivation: Ignition OFF and vehicle locked (transitions to 100% opaque thermal sleep mode to block cabin solar heating).. Override: Manual touch slider on overhead console provides instant override of automated solar tinting; emergency glass defrost clears frost..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-ECR-01: Prevent high-voltage AC insulation breakdown to vehicle chassis (< 110V AC @ 400 Hz); maintain driver visibility through electrochromic windshield tint band. | FTTI: 50 ms for AC insulation fault; 200 ms for voltage regulation. | Safe State: Discharge electrochromic glass electrodes; disconnect AC drive inverter (glass naturally defaults to opaque safe state)..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-BDY-06)

##### `SYS-BDY-06-01`: Segmented Suspended Particle Device (SPD) Optical Transmittance Synthesis [QM] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL modulate AC drive voltage (0 to 110V AC RMS @ 400 Hz) across 9 individual glass segments to control light transmittance smoothly from 0.5% (dark opaque) to 55% (clear transparent) within <= 3.0 seconds.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 200 ms | Safe State: Zero AC drive voltage; return all segments to 0.5% opaque quiescent state.
- **Failure Reaction:** If individual segment electrode breaks, isolate segment and maintain others.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-06-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-06_EC-ROOF_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-06-01), [`SWR-BDY-06-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-06_EC-ROOF_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-06-02)

##### `SYS-BDY-06-02`: Solar Heat Flux Load Reduction & Galvanic Chassis Isolation Supervision [ASIL A] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL evaluate ambient solar irradiation (W/m²) and vehicle interior temperature to automatically adjust roof tint to reject up to 98% of solar infrared heat, while continuously monitoring 400 Hz AC chassis leakage current (< 1.0 mA).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Disconnect AC inverter; isolate high-voltage drive circuit.
- **Failure Reaction:** If AC leakage to vehicle ground exceeds 1.0 mA, immediately shut down inverter.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-06-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-06_EC-ROOF_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-06-03), [`SWR-BDY-06-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-06_EC-ROOF_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-06-04)

##### `SYS-BDY-06-03`: Electrochromic Glass Segmented Suspended Particle Device (SPD) PWM Driver [ASIL A] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Modulate 110V AC high-frequency PWM drive to SPD glass film to alter roof glass tint from 5% to 65%.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-BDY-06-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-06_EC-ROOF_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-06-05), [`SWR-BDY-06-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-BDY-06_EC-ROOF_SwReq.md#swr-bdy-06-06)

##### `SYS-BDY-06-04`: Multi-Zone Glass Roof Segment Independent Opacity Area Controller [ASIL A] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Control opacity of 9 independent glass roof segments individually (e.g. driver opaque, passenger clear).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.

## Digital Cockpit, HMI & Cabin Sensing

### FEAT-CPT-01: Driver Monitoring & Cabin Sensing (DMS/OMS)
- **Domain:** Digital Cockpit, HMI & Cabin Sensing | **Target ASIL:** ASIL B
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-CPT-01_DMS_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-CPT-01_DMS_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-CPT-01_DMS_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-01_DMS_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Monitors driver gaze, eye closure (PERCLOS), head orientation, and cabin occupant presence (child left behind detection) using near-infrared cameras and 60 GHz radar.
- **Activation Logic:** 12V system active, cabin NIR camera stream running at 30 fps, cockpit domain controller healthy. Entry: Vehicle ignition in RUN, or vehicle parked with doors locked (for Occupant Child Left Behind detection).. Deactivation: Driver monitoring inactive when ignition is completely OFF and vehicle unlocked.. Override: Driver gaze return to road forward cone for > 1.5s immediately clears distraction warning state..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-DMS-01: Detect driver microsleep or eyes-off-road inattention within 2.5 seconds; detect unattended child in parked vehicle. | FTTI: 500 ms | Safe State: Report DMS_Status = DEGRADED to ADAS; disallow Level 2/3 hands-free automated driving modes..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-CPT-01)

##### `SYS-CPT-01-01`: 3D Head Pose & Eyelid Closure (PERCLOS) Real-Time Inference [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL track driver eye gaze vector (+-10 deg accuracy), head pose (pitch, yaw, roll +-5 deg), and compute PERCLOS metric at >= 30 fps under day, night, and sunglasses conditions.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 250 ms | Safe State: Set Driver_Attentive_Flag = FALSE; alert ADAS.
- **Failure Reaction:** If facial landmarks lost for > 2.0 seconds, trigger driver attentiveness check.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CPT-01-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-01_DMS_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-01-01), [`SWR-CPT-01-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-01_DMS_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-01-02)

##### `SYS-CPT-01-02`: Parked Vehicle Child Presence Detection & Alarm Escalation [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL scan passenger cabin using 60 GHz in-cabin radar and camera within 60 seconds of vehicle locking to detect sub-millimeter chest movements of sleeping infants, escalating honk and cellular alerts.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 5000 ms | Safe State: Crack open power windows by 3 cm; activate maximum blower fan; notify owner smartphone.
- **Failure Reaction:** If radar sensor self-test fails, notify owner via mobile app of cabin sensor failure.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CPT-01-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-01_DMS_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-01-03), [`SWR-CPT-01-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-01_DMS_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-01-04)

##### `SYS-CPT-01-03`: Cabin 60 GHz Millimeter-Wave Radar Child Presence Detection (CPD) [ASIL B / Euro NCAP] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL sample cabin roof-mounted 60 GHz FMCW radar at 20 Hz, detecting micro-movements of breathing (sub-millimeter chest displacement 0.2 to 0.5 Hz) to detect unattended infants/children covered under blankets in <= 10 seconds of vehicle key-off.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 2000 ms | Safe State: Lower windows 2 cm; trigger external horn chirp; send emergency smartphone push notification.
- **Failure Reaction:** If radar sensor reports RF fault, fallback to interior ultrasonic intrusion sensor.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CPT-01-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-01_DMS_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-01-05), [`SWR-CPT-01-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-01_DMS_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-01-06)

##### `SYS-CPT-01-04`: Driver Cognitive Distraction & Handheld Mobile Phone Usage Classifier [ASIL A] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL track driver hand pose and facial gaze vectors: If driver is holding mobile phone to ear or texting while vehicle speed > 10 km/h for > 2.5 seconds, system SHALL trigger Level 1 visual and Level 2 acoustic distraction warnings.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 500 ms | Safe State: Display amber distraction prompt on instrument cluster.
- **Failure Reaction:** Suppress false alarms if driver is wearing sunglasses by relying on hand-to-ear skeletal pose.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CPT-01-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-01_DMS_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-01-07), [`SWR-CPT-01-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-01_DMS_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-01-08)

##### `SYS-CPT-01-05`: Driver Medical Incapacitation & Emergency Safe Stop Coordinator [ASIL D] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL continuously monitor driver responsiveness: If driver head slumps forward (pitch < -40 deg) with eyes closed for > 4.0 seconds and zero hands on steering wheel, system SHALL declare Driver_Incapacitated, initiating autonomous in-lane stop and emergency hazard beacon.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 200 ms | Safe State: Bring vehicle to controlled stop; unlock doors; initiate eCall medical alert.
- **Failure Reaction:** Cancel emergency stop immediately if driver lifts head and steers wheel.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CPT-01-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-01_DMS_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-01-09), [`SWR-CPT-01-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-01_DMS_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-01-10)

##### `SYS-CPT-01-06`: Near-Infrared (NIR) 940nm LED Illumination Driver & Eye Exposure Safety [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Modulate 940 nm NIR illumination strobes synchronized with camera shutter, conforming to IEC 62471 eye safety.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 30 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CPT-01-11`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-01_DMS_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-01-11), [`SWR-CPT-01-12`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-01_DMS_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-01-12)

##### `SYS-CPT-01-07`: Driver Facial Landmark 68-Point Mesh Real-Time 3D Geometric Tracker [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Track facial landmarks at 30 fps to reconstruct head pose orientation (pitch, yaw, roll +-1.5°).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 33 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CPT-01-13`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-01_DMS_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-01-13), [`SWR-CPT-01-14`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-01_DMS_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-01-14)

##### `SYS-CPT-01-08`: Eye Gaze Vector Estimation & Instrument Cluster / Windshield Zone Classifier [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Determine driver visual fixation zone (Road Ahead, Cluster, Center Display, Phone, Mirrors) at 30 Hz.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 33 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CPT-01-15`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-01_DMS_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-01-15), [`SWR-CPT-01-16`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-01_DMS_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-01-16)

##### `SYS-CPT-01-09`: PERCLOS Percentage Eye Closure Drowsiness Index Evaluator [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Compute percentage of eye closure over 60-second sliding window: Trigger fatigue alert if PERCLOS > 12.0%.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CPT-01-17`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-01_DMS_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-01-17), [`SWR-CPT-01-18`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-01_DMS_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-01-18)

##### `SYS-CPT-01-10`: Visual Inattention & Extended Eye-Off-Road Distraction Time Tracker [ASIL B] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Assert Level 1 audio/visual distraction alert if driver gaze looks away from road forward zone for > 2.0s.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CPT-01-19`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-01_DMS_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-01-19), [`SWR-CPT-01-20`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-01_DMS_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-01-20)

##### `SYS-CPT-01-11`: Micro-Sleep & Closed Eyelid Acute Incapacitation Emergency Escalation [ASIL B] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Detect continuous eye closure > 1.5s while vehicle moving (> 20 km/h); sound urgent high-pitch alarm chime.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 30 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CPT-01-21`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-01_DMS_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-01-21), [`SWR-CPT-01-22`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-01_DMS_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-01-22)

##### `SYS-CPT-01-12`: Cabin Occupant Monitoring System (OMS) Rear Seat Passenger Presence Detector [ASIL B] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Detect presence of adult, child, or pet in rear seating positions using wide-angle cabin camera.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 200 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.

### FEAT-CPT-02: Augmented Reality Head-Up Display (AR-HUD)
- **Domain:** Digital Cockpit, HMI & Cabin Sensing | **Target ASIL:** ASIL B
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-CPT-02_HUD_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-CPT-02_HUD_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-CPT-02_HUD_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-02_HUD_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Projects conformal optical graphics (navigation arrows, ADAS target boxes, lane boundaries) onto windshield at 10-meter virtual focal distance.
- **Activation Logic:** 12V system healthy, HUD optical picture generating unit (PGU) temperature normal, windshield projection mirror calibrated. Entry: Ignition in RUN; driver enables HUD in cockpit display settings.. Deactivation: Driver toggles HUD OFF or ignition powered down.. Override: Driver can adjust virtual image height and rotation via steering wheel buttons..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-HUD-01: Prevent visual obstruction of driver forward road view; ensure graphics align accurately with real-world objects (< 1.0 deg error). | FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Immediately turn off PGU laser/TFT backlight to extinguish projected image..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-CPT-02)

##### `SYS-CPT-02-01`: Low-Latency Ego-Motion Graphic Conformal Alignment [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL render navigation arrows and ADAS hazard bounding boxes conformally aligned with real-world geometry (< 0.5 deg alignment error) with motion-to-photon latency <= 30 ms at 60 fps.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 60 ms | Safe State: Blank optical display if graphic lag exceeds 50 ms.
- **Failure Reaction:** Revert to simple static numeric speed display if AR pose tracker faults.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CPT-02-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-02_HUD_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-02-01), [`SWR-CPT-02-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-02_HUD_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-02-02)

##### `SYS-CPT-02-02`: Ambient Light Ambient Adaptation & Solar Thermal Protection [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL adjust HUD projection luminance from 100 nits (night) to 15,000 nits (direct snow sunlight) in <= 200 ms, while monitoring cold-mirror thermal sensor to prevent sun-burn damage to TFT panel.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 200 ms | Safe State: Close motorized optical glare trap shutter if solar thermal risk detected.
- **Failure Reaction:** If ambient lux sensor fails, set brightness to safe default 3,000 nits.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CPT-02-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-02_HUD_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-02-03), [`SWR-CPT-02-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-02_HUD_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-02-04)

##### `SYS-CPT-02-03`: Real-Time World-Grounding Parallax & Eye-Box Pupil Tracking [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL sample driver pupil 3D coordinates via DMS camera at 60 Hz, adjusting AR projection ray matrix in <= 16 ms to eliminate motion parallax and keep virtual navigation arrows anchored to physical road lanes within +-0.5 degrees optical accuracy.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 30 ms | Safe State: Switch AR graphics to static non-conformal 2D HUD projection.
- **Failure Reaction:** If driver eyes are obscured by sunglasses, default to average 50th percentile eye-box center.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CPT-02-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-02_HUD_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-02-05), [`SWR-CPT-02-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-02_HUD_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-02-06)

##### `SYS-CPT-02-04`: Optical DLP Laser Picture Generation Unit (PGU) Thermal Protector [ASIL A] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL monitor Digital Light Processing (DLP) RGB laser diode temperatures, dynamically scaling laser power (0 to 100% luminance up to 15,000 nits) to preserve daytime visibility under direct sunlight while preventing laser thermal burnout (> 75°C).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 200 ms | Safe State: Dim laser power to 20% baseline luminance.
- **Failure Reaction:** Shut off laser diode driver if PGU internal temperature exceeds 85°C.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CPT-02-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-02_HUD_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-02-07), [`SWR-CPT-02-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-02_HUD_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-02-08)

##### `SYS-CPT-02-05`: Digital Micro-Mirror (DMD) Optical Projection Engine Sub-Pixel Color Renderer [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Render 1280x720 RGB projection graphics at 60 fps with high contrast ratio (>= 1500:1).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 16 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.

## Cockpit Electronics & Acoustic Safety

### FEAT-CPT-03: Digital Instrument Cluster with ASIL B Safety Island (DIC-SI)
- **Domain:** Cockpit Electronics & Acoustic Safety | **Target ASIL:** ASIL B / ISO 26262
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-CPT-03_CLUSTER_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-CPT-03_CLUSTER_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-CPT-03_CLUSTER_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-03_CLUSTER_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** High-resolution digital driver instrument display combining rich 3D graphics on high-performance GPU with an independent ASIL B hardware safety island supervising critical tell-tales, vehicle speed display, and freeze-frame detection.
- **Activation Logic:** 12V system voltage >= 9.0V, Display LVDS/eDP serializer locked, Safety Island lockstep microcontroller energized. Entry: Driver door opened, remote key detected, or ignition switched to ACCESSORY / RUN.. Deactivation: Ignition switched to OFF, driver door opened, and vehicle locked (transitions to quiescent sleep after 60s delay).. Override: If primary infotainment GPU crashes or freezes, Safety Island hardware multiplexer takes exclusive control of display within 50 ms to render essential speedometer and warnings..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-CPT-01: Guarantee accurate display of vehicle speed (+-1 km/h) and safety tell-tales (Brakes, Airbags, ABS, ESC, Steering); prevent display freeze without driver warning. | FTTI: 100 ms for frozen image detection; 50 ms for critical tell-tale activation. | Safe State: Safety Island asserts hardware 2D overlay; forces secondary display pipeline to render raw numerical speed and emergency tell-tales..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-CPT-03)

##### `SYS-CPT-03-01`: Hardware Safety Island Lockstep Supervisor & Frame Freeze Detector [ASIL B] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL implement an independent ASIL B dual-core lockstep microcontroller supervising the primary SoC GPU via hardware frame CRC-32 signatures and heartbeat ping-pong watchdog, seizing display panel control via hardware multiplexer in <= 50 ms upon GPU failure.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Switch display multiplexer to Safety Island 2D emergency rendering pipeline.
- **Failure Reaction:** If SoC fails to respond to watchdog ping within 60 ms, assert SoC hardware reset line.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CPT-03-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-03_CLUSTER_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-03-01), [`SWR-CPT-03-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-03_CLUSTER_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-03-02)

##### `SYS-CPT-03-02`: ISO 2575 Safety Tell-Tale Manager & Hardware Piezo Buzzer Chime [ASIL B / FMVSS 101] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL monitor safety-critical tell-tale status signals (Airbag, ABS, ESC, EPB, Red Brake Warning, EPS) over E2E-protected CAN-FD at 20 ms period, rendering dedicated compliant ISO 2575 warning icons and driving dual-coil hardware piezo chimes in <= 50 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Illuminate hardware-driven physical LED tell-tales; trigger continuous 1.2 kHz piezo buzzer chime.
- **Failure Reaction:** If tell-tale CAN-FD frame suffers E2E CRC error for >= 3 frames, illuminate corresponding tell-tale in latched fault state.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CPT-03-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-03_CLUSTER_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-03-03), [`SWR-CPT-03-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-03_CLUSTER_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-03-04)

##### `SYS-CPT-03-03`: Dual Microcontroller Core Architecture ASIL B Safety Island Hardware Core [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Separate safety-critical tell-tales (brakes, airbag, steering) into isolated hardware domain from Linux UI.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CPT-03-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-03_CLUSTER_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-03-05), [`SWR-CPT-03-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-03_CLUSTER_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-03-06)

##### `SYS-CPT-03-04`: Safety-Critical Optical Tell-Tale Lamp Display Controller & Pixel Echo Checker [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Render brake, steering, and airbag warning icons, verifying framebuffer CRC via hardware pixel echo capture.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.

### FEAT-CPT-04: Acoustic Vehicle Alerting & Active Road Noise Cancellation (AVAS-RNC)
- **Domain:** Cockpit Electronics & Acoustic Safety | **Target ASIL:** ASIL B / UNECE R138
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-CPT-04_AVAS-RNC_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-CPT-04_AVAS-RNC_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-CPT-04_AVAS-RNC_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-04_AVAS-RNC_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Dual external and internal acoustic system providing regulatory pedestrian warning sounds (AVAS) outside the vehicle and real-time active road noise cancellation (RNC) inside the cabin using chassis accelerometers.
- **Activation Logic:** 12V system voltage >= 11.0V, external waterproof speaker healthy, cabin audio DSP initialized. Entry: For AVAS: Vehicle powered and moving forward or reverse at speeds <= 30 km/h (UNECE R138 / FMVSS 141). For RNC: Vehicle speed > 20 km/h with windows closed.. Deactivation: Vehicle speed > 30 km/h (AVAS automatically fades out); vehicle stopped or window open (RNC pauses).. Override: Temporary AVAS pause switch is prohibited in jurisdictions conforming to UNECE R138 Rev 1; reversing sound cannot be defeated..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-AVAS-01: Ensure continuous acoustic pedestrian audibility for quiet electric vehicle operation (minimum sound pressure levels in 1/3-octave bands 160 Hz to 5000 Hz according to UNECE R138); prevent speaker coil disconnect without driver notice. | FTTI: 200 ms for speaker impedance disconnect detection. | Safe State: Illuminate cluster 'AVAS Fault' warning tell-tale; sound low-speed warning via secondary backup horn if primary AVAS speaker open-circuited..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-CPT-04)

##### `SYS-CPT-04-01`: UNECE R138 Speed-Proportional Acoustic Pedestrian Synthesis [ASIL B / UNECE R138] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL synthesize regulatory acoustic pedestrian warning sound streams from 0 km/h to 30 km/h with sound pressure level between 56 dB(A) and 75 dB(A) and pitch shift (+-0.8% per km/h) matching vehicle speed, broadcasting through front/rear waterproof speakers in <= 50 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 200 ms | Safe State: Switch to backup external horn pulse mode; illuminate cluster warning.
- **Failure Reaction:** If vehicle speed CAN-FD signal lost, play baseline 20 km/h sound continuously while in DRIVE.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CPT-04-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-04_AVAS-RNC_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-04-01), [`SWR-CPT-04-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-04_AVAS-RNC_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-04-02)

##### `SYS-CPT-04-02`: Multi-Channel Chassis Accelerometer Active Road Noise Cancellation [QM] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL sample 4 structural suspension chassis accelerometers (up to 1000 Hz) and 4 cabin error microphones, computing anti-phase acoustic cancellation waveforms in <= 3 ms to attenuate low-frequency road rumble (30 Hz to 250 Hz) by >= 6 dB at occupant ear positions.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: N/A | Safe State: Zero cancellation audio output; fade out anti-phase signals over 200 ms.
- **Failure Reaction:** If any error microphone detects positive feedback (howling), ramp anti-noise gain to 0.0 in < 20 ms.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CPT-04-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-04_AVAS-RNC_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-04-03), [`SWR-CPT-04-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-04_AVAS-RNC_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-04-04)

##### `SYS-CPT-04-03`: Acoustic Vehicle Alerting System (AVAS) UNECE R138 Minimum Sound Pressure Level Synthesizer [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Synthesize external engine-like sound at speeds 0 to 20 km/h conforming to 56 to 75 dBA sound pressure limits.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CPT-04-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-04_AVAS-RNC_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-04-05), [`SWR-CPT-04-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-04_AVAS-RNC_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-04-06)

##### `SYS-CPT-04-04`: Forward / Reverse Directional Sound Pitch Shift Frequency Modulator [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Modulate acoustic sound pitch proportionally to vehicle speed (minimum 0.8% frequency shift per km/h).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CPT-04-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-04_AVAS-RNC_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-04-07), [`SWR-CPT-04-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-04_AVAS-RNC_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-04-08)

##### `SYS-CPT-04-05`: Dual Exterior Weather-Sealed Loudspeaker Impedance & Continuity Diagnostics [ASIL B] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Measure front and rear exterior loudspeaker coil impedance at 10 Hz; flag DTC B1412 if speaker disconnected.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-CPT-04-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-04_AVAS-RNC_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-04-09), [`SWR-CPT-04-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-CPT-04_AVAS-RNC_SwReq.md#swr-cpt-04-10)

##### `SYS-CPT-04-06`: AVAS Sound Synthesis Temporary Driver Pause Switch Regulation (Restricted) [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Inhibit temporary sound muting unless specifically permitted by local jurisdiction; re-arm at next key cycle.

## Connectivity, Security & Diagnostics

### FEAT-TEL-01: Firmware Over-The-Air (FOTA) Update Orchestrator
- **Domain:** Connectivity, Security & Diagnostics | **Target ASIL:** ASIL B / ISO 21434 / UNECE R156
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-TEL-01_FOTA_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-TEL-01_FOTA_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-TEL-01_FOTA_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-01_FOTA_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Downloads, cryptographically verifies, stages, and flashes firmware updates across vehicle ECUs with A/B dual-bank memory rollback protection.
- **Activation Logic:** Vehicle parked in PARK, battery SOC > 50%, 12V auxiliary battery > 12.4V, vehicle speed == 0 km/h, cellular connection stable. Entry: Cloud manifest downloaded and verified; user confirms 'Update Now' or scheduled overnight install window opens.. Deactivation: Update sequence successfully completed, or pre-condition violation forces abort prior to flashing.. Override: Driver opening door or turning ignition on during installation is prohibited by software lock until critical flashing phase completes..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-FOTA-01: Prevent execution of corrupted or malicious firmware; prevent bricking ECUs; prevent vehicle immobilization. | FTTI: N/A (Quiescent safe state) | Safe State: Autonomous hardware watchdog rollback to intact Bank A flash memory if new Bank B fails post-install boot self-test..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-TEL-01)

##### `SYS-TEL-01-01`: Cryptographic Package Signature & Integrity Verification [ISO 21434 / ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL verify digital signatures of received update manifests and firmware binaries using RSA-4096 / ECDSA-P384 and SHA-256 with Hardware Security Module (HSM) root-of-trust prior to staging.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: N/A | Safe State: Purge staged flash memory; report failed authentication to cloud backend.
- **Failure Reaction:** If root certificate chain is invalid, terminate session and quarantine package.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-TEL-01-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-01_FOTA_SwReq.md#swr-tel-01-01), [`SWR-TEL-01-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-01_FOTA_SwReq.md#swr-tel-01-02)

##### `SYS-TEL-01-02`: Vehicle Pre-Condition Safety Interlocks Verification [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL prohibit flash execution unless: Vehicle in PARK, Vehicle Speed == 0 km/h, 12V Battery >= 12.4V, High-Voltage SOC >= 50%, Hazard Lights functional, and driver consent confirmed.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Abort update; keep vehicle in drivable state.
- **Failure Reaction:** If 12V battery drops below 12.0V during staging, abort update and engage 12V DC-DC charger.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-TEL-01-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-01_FOTA_SwReq.md#swr-tel-01-03), [`SWR-TEL-01-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-01_FOTA_SwReq.md#swr-tel-01-04)

##### `SYS-TEL-01-03`: A/B Dual-Bank Flash Orchestration & Self-Test Rollback [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL write new software into secondary flash bank (Bank B). If target ECU fails startup self-tests within 60 seconds post-boot, the system SHALL autonomously revert boot flags to Bank A in <= 5 seconds.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 5000 ms | Safe State: Revert to known good Bank A firmware; restore full vehicle drivability.
- **Failure Reaction:** If Bank B crashes micro, hardware watchdog toggles boot pin to Bank A.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-TEL-01-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-01_FOTA_SwReq.md#swr-tel-01-05), [`SWR-TEL-01-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-01_FOTA_SwReq.md#swr-tel-01-06)

##### `SYS-TEL-01-04`: Cellular 5G Differential Delta Binary Compression & Chunk Stager [ASIL B / UNECE R156] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL download compressed differential delta patches (reducing payload size by >= 75% compared to full binary images) over 5G/4G, reconstructing target flash binary in external non-volatile eMMC staging memory with SHA-256 chunk verification.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: N/A (Quiescent download) | Safe State: Purge corrupted chunks; resume download from last valid byte offset.
- **Failure Reaction:** If cellular signal drops below -115 dBm RSRP, pause download and resume when signal recovers.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-TEL-01-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-01_FOTA_SwReq.md#swr-tel-01-07), [`SWR-TEL-01-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-01_FOTA_SwReq.md#swr-tel-01-08)

##### `SYS-TEL-01-05`: Fleet Campaign Management, User Scheduling & Rollback Logger [ISO 24089 / UNECE R156] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL interface with OEM cloud campaign servers to report install progress, allow driver to schedule overnight installation windows (e.g. 02:00 AM), and securely record diagnostic rollback events into non-volatile audit log upon installation failure.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: N/A | Safe State: Keep current operational firmware intact; notify backend of campaign pause.
- **Failure Reaction:** If user initiates vehicle drive during scheduled window, postpone update automatically.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-TEL-01-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-01_FOTA_SwReq.md#swr-tel-01-09), [`SWR-TEL-01-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-01_FOTA_SwReq.md#swr-tel-01-10)

##### `SYS-TEL-01-06`: UNECE R156 Software Update Management System (SUMS) Cryptographic Manifest Validator [ASIL B] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Verify RSA-3072 / ECDSA digital signature and SHA-256 hash of inbound firmware update manifest.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 500 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-TEL-01-11`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-01_FOTA_SwReq.md#swr-tel-01-11), [`SWR-TEL-01-12`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-01_FOTA_SwReq.md#swr-tel-01-12)

##### `SYS-TEL-01-07`: A/B Dual-Bank Flash Memory Hardware Swap & Atomic Rollback Engine [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Flash secondary memory bank in background; execute atomic bank switchover during vehicle sleep mode.
