### FEAT-TEL-02: Cellular Vehicle-to-Everything Safety Warnings (C-V2X)
- **Domain:** Connectivity, Security & Diagnostics | **Target ASIL:** ASIL B
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-TEL-02_V2X_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-TEL-02_V2X_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-TEL-02_V2X_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-02_V2X_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Transmits and receives 5.9 GHz PC5 direct sidelink V2X messages (BSM / CAM / DENM) to warn driver of non-line-of-sight collisions, emergency vehicles, and road hazards.
- **Activation Logic:** 12V system active, V2X transceiver RF frontend healthy, GNSS time synchronization achieved (< 1 us). Entry: Vehicle powered up; C-V2X PC5 direct mode enabled.. Deactivation: Vehicle powered down or GNSS time synchronization lost for > 60 seconds.. Override: Driver can dismiss visual V2X information popups; safety critical warnings cannot be muted..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-V2X-01: Provide timely warnings for non-line-of-sight collisions (blind intersections, curve hazards); prevent false warnings caused by spoofed V2X packets. | FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Silence unverified V2X warnings; revert to on-board radar/camera detection only..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-TEL-02)

##### `SYS-TEL-02-01`: 5.9 GHz PC5 Direct Sidelink BSM Broadcast & Reception [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL broadcast Basic Safety Messages (BSM / CAM) containing vehicle position, speed, heading, and curvature at 10 Hz (100 ms), and process inbound peer messages within <= 20 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Halt transmission if positioning accuracy degrades > 5.0 m.
- **Failure Reaction:** If RF power amplifier overheats, reduce transmit power from 23 dBm to 10 dBm.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-TEL-02-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-02_V2X_SwReq.md#swr-tel-02-01), [`SWR-TEL-02-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-02_V2X_SwReq.md#swr-tel-02-02)

##### `SYS-TEL-02-02`: Non-Line-of-Sight Hazard Evaluation & Driver Alerting [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL evaluate inbound V2X messages to detect Emergency Electronic Brake Lights (EEBL), Blind Intersection Collision Warning (ICW), and Approaching Emergency Vehicle (EVW) up to 300 m away, issuing alerts <= 50 ms post-reception.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Do not alert driver if packet cryptographic certificate cannot be validated.
- **Failure Reaction:** If peer packet timestamp is skewed > 500 ms from local time, drop packet as replay.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-TEL-02-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-02_V2X_SwReq.md#swr-tel-02-03), [`SWR-TEL-02-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-02_V2X_SwReq.md#swr-tel-02-04)

##### `SYS-TEL-02-03`: Cellular V2X (C-V2X) PC5 Direct Sidelink 5.9 GHz RF Transceiver Interface [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Interface with PC5 direct communication chipset to broadcast and receive safety messages at 5.9 GHz.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-TEL-02-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-02_V2X_SwReq.md#swr-tel-02-05), [`SWR-TEL-02-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-02_V2X_SwReq.md#swr-tel-02-06)

##### `SYS-TEL-02-04`: SAE J2735 / ETSI Basic Safety Message (BSM / CAM) Dynamic Encoder [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Encode vehicle position, heading, velocity, acceleration, and brake status into BSM frames at 10 Hz.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-TEL-02-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-02_V2X_SwReq.md#swr-tel-02-07), [`SWR-TEL-02-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-02_V2X_SwReq.md#swr-tel-02-08)

##### `SYS-TEL-02-05`: Intersection Collision Warning (ICW) Blind Crossing Path Evaluator [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Compute collision risk with cross-traffic vehicles transmitting BSMs at non-line-of-sight intersections.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-TEL-02-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-02_V2X_SwReq.md#swr-tel-02-09), [`SWR-TEL-02-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-02_V2X_SwReq.md#swr-tel-02-10)

##### `SYS-TEL-02-06`: Emergency Electronic Brake Light (EEBL) Remote Vehicle Hard Braking Receiver [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Receive EEBL alert from lead vehicle braking heavily beyond sightline (300 m ahead); notify driver.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.

- **Statement:** The System SHALL Detect approaching ambulance or fire truck transmitting EVA packets; prompt driver to clear lane.

### FEAT-TEL-03: Automatic Emergency Call & Crash Data Dispatch (eCall / ERA-GLONASS)
- **Domain:** Connectivity, Security & Diagnostics | **Target ASIL:** ASIL B / UNECE R144
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-TEL-03_eCall_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-TEL-03_eCall_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-TEL-03_eCall_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-03_eCall_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Autonomous regulatory crash notification and emergency voice dispatch system transmitting Minimum Set of Data (MSD) to emergency PSAP over cellular 4G/5G IMS VoLTE or 2G/3G in-band modem with autonomous backup battery.
- **Activation Logic:** NAD cellular modem registered, GNSS receiver locked, internal backup battery SOC >= 70%, audio mic and crash speaker connected. Entry: Automatic trigger: Airbag ECU crash pulse discrete line pulled LOW; OR Manual trigger: Driver presses overhead SOS button for >= 2.0 seconds.. Deactivation: Call successfully ended by PSAP emergency operator; manual cancel button pressed within 5.0 seconds grace window (manual triggers only).. Override: Automatic crash trigger CANNOT be cancelled by occupants under any circumstances; manual SOS trigger allows 5-second countdown cancel before cellular dialing..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-ECALL-01: Guarantee MSD transmission and two-way voice connection to emergency services within 30 seconds of severe collision (UNECE R144); operate for >= 60 minutes on internal backup battery if main 12V supply severed. | FTTI: 50 ms for crash pulse latching; 2000 ms for cellular dialing. | Safe State: Switch to internal 3.7V / 6.4V telematics backup battery; lock crash MSD into flash memory; prioritize emergency call over all consumer cellular data traffic..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-TEL-03)

##### `SYS-TEL-03-01`: Hardware Crash Pulse Discrete Ingestion & CEN EN 15722 MSD Assembler [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL sample hardwired discrete crash output lines from Airbag ECU at 1 kHz, validating crash pulse in <= 5 ms, and assemble standard Minimum Set of Data (MSD conforming to CEN EN 15722 / GOST R 54620) containing VIN, timestamp, accurate GNSS position (+-5 m), heading, passenger count, and collision delta-V in <= 500 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Persist MSD to non-volatile flash memory; initiate emergency call sequence.
- **Failure Reaction:** If GNSS position is lost at crash moment, extrapolate last valid fix using dead-reckoning IMU heading and wheel distance.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-TEL-03-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-03_eCall_SwReq.md#swr-tel-03-01), [`SWR-TEL-03-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-03_eCall_SwReq.md#swr-tel-03-02)

##### `SYS-TEL-03-02`: Next-Gen VoLTE Emergency Call Orchestration & Power Cutover [ASIL B / UNECE R144] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL initiate Next-Gen eCall SIP INVITE (RFC 8147) over LTE/5G IMS with in-band modem fallback in <= 5.0 seconds of trigger, routing full-duplex voice to dedicated crash speaker and microphone, while maintaining operation on autonomous internal backup battery for >= 60 minutes after main 12V bus loss.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 2000 ms | Safe State: Maintain emergency session across cellular handover; retry call until PSAP terminates.
- **Failure Reaction:** If VoLTE IMS registration fails, drop to legacy circuit-switched 2G/3G in-band modem transmission within 10.0 seconds.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-TEL-03-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-03_eCall_SwReq.md#swr-tel-03-03), [`SWR-TEL-03-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-03_eCall_SwReq.md#swr-tel-03-04)

##### `SYS-TEL-03-03`: UNECE R144 Minimum Set of Data (MSD) Crash Telemetry Message Assembler [ASIL B] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Assemble 140-byte MSD packet containing GPS coordinates, vehicle VIN, propulsion type, and direction.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-TEL-03-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-03_eCall_SwReq.md#swr-tel-03-05), [`SWR-TEL-03-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-03_eCall_SwReq.md#swr-tel-03-06)

##### `SYS-TEL-03-04`: Automatic Crash Detection Airbag Deployment Pyrotechnic Trigger Interface [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Trigger automated eCall sequence within <= 100 ms of receiving airbag pyrotechnic deployment signal.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-TEL-03-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-03_eCall_SwReq.md#swr-tel-03-07), [`SWR-TEL-03-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-TEL-03_eCall_SwReq.md#swr-tel-03-08)

### FEAT-SEC-01: Central Security Gateway & SecOC Intrusion Detection
- **Domain:** Connectivity, Security & Diagnostics | **Target ASIL:** ASIL B / ISO 21434
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-SEC-01_SecOC_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-SEC-01_SecOC_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-SEC-01_SecOC_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-SEC-01_SecOC_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Authenticates critical in-vehicle bus communication using AES-128-CMAC and monotonic freshness values, filtering unauthorized packets and detecting Denial-of-Service attacks.
- **Activation Logic:** Hardware Security Module (HSM) secure boot verified, cryptographic session keys loaded into hardware keystore. Entry: Central Gateway powered up and forwarding in-vehicle bus traffic.. Deactivation: Gateway power down.. Override: UDS Diagnostic Security Access (Service 0x27) temporarily unlocks engineering routing tables upon valid cryptographic key handshake..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-SEC-01: Prevent unauthorized command injection, replay attacks, or bus-flooding denial of service on safety-critical chassis and powertrain networks. | FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Drop unauthenticated frames immediately; isolate compromised network segments..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-SEC-01)

##### `SYS-SEC-01-01`: AUTOSAR SecOC Cryptographic Message Authentication & Freshness Counter [ASIL B / ISO 21434] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL compute and verify a 64-bit truncated AES-128-CMAC and monotonic Freshness Value on all safety-critical CAN-FD and SOME/IP messages with <= 1.0 ms processing latency per message.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 5 ms | Safe State: Discard unauthenticated PDU; do not pass to application SWCs.
- **Failure Reaction:** If 5 consecutive verification failures occur from an ECU, flag ECU as compromised.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-SEC-01-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-SEC-01_SecOC_SwReq.md#swr-sec-01-01), [`SWR-SEC-01-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-SEC-01_SecOC_SwReq.md#swr-sec-01-02)

##### `SYS-SEC-01-02`: Central Gateway Firewall Whitelist Filtering & DoS Rate Limiting [QM / ISO 21434] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The Central Gateway SHALL filter Ethernet SOME/IP and CAN-FD routing tables against a static whitelist, dropping unauthorized message IDs and rate-limiting broadcast packets exceeding 1000 msg/s.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Halt routing on flooded port; preserve bandwidth on remaining critical ports.
- **Failure Reaction:** If port flood exceeds 5000 msg/s, isolate physical Ethernet switch port.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-SEC-01-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-SEC-01_SecOC_SwReq.md#swr-sec-01-03), [`SWR-SEC-01-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-SEC-01_SecOC_SwReq.md#swr-sec-01-04)

##### `SYS-SEC-01-03`: Hardware Security Module (HSM) Isolated Key Store & Secure Boot [ASIL D / ISO 21434] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL implement an isolated on-chip Hardware Security Module (HSM with dedicated crypto core, RAM, and ROM) storing symmetric AES-128 keys and private ECC keys, executing authenticated Secure Boot in <= 35 ms from reset to prevent untrusted firmware execution.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Lock microcontroller in bootloader quarantine mode; assert external reset pin.
- **Failure Reaction:** If Secure Boot cryptographic signature check fails, halt execution and illuminate security indicator.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-SEC-01-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-SEC-01_SecOC_SwReq.md#swr-sec-01-05), [`SWR-SEC-01-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-SEC-01_SecOC_SwReq.md#swr-sec-01-06)

##### `SYS-SEC-01-04`: Vehicle Network Intrusion Detection System (IDS) & Anomaly Firewall [ISO 21434 / UNECE R155] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL monitor CAN-FD, LIN, and Automotive Ethernet traffic at line rate, detecting bus flooding (> 85% bus load), unexpected CAN ID spoofing, diagnostic service brute-force attempts, and unauthorized cyclic frame jitter, logging security events in <= 5 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Quarantine offending network segment; filter malicious frames at hardware gateway.
- **Failure Reaction:** Block corrupted CAN ID messages while keeping safety-critical chassis communication open.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-SEC-01-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-SEC-01_SecOC_SwReq.md#swr-sec-01-07), [`SWR-SEC-01-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-SEC-01_SecOC_SwReq.md#swr-sec-01-08)

##### `SYS-SEC-01-05`: AUTOSAR Secure On-Board Communication (SecOC) AES-128 CMAC Verifier [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Verify 64-bit truncated AES-128 CMAC on critical chassis and powertrain CAN-FD frames in <= 2.0 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 5 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-SEC-01-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-SEC-01_SecOC_SwReq.md#swr-sec-01-09), [`SWR-SEC-01-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-SEC-01_SecOC_SwReq.md#swr-sec-01-10)

##### `SYS-SEC-01-06`: SecOC Freshness Value Manager (FVM) Synchronization & Trip Counter Engine [ASIL B] [Release: R200]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Manage synchronized monotonic trip counter and reset counters to eliminate message replay attacks.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 5 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-SEC-01-11`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-SEC-01_SecOC_SwReq.md#swr-sec-01-11), [`SWR-SEC-01-12`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-SEC-01_SecOC_SwReq.md#swr-sec-01-12)

##### `SYS-SEC-01-07`: Central Security Gateway CAN-FD / Ethernet Stateful Packet Firewall [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Filter network traffic across domain buses: Drop unauthorized CAN IDs and illegal payload formats in < 1 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 2 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-SEC-01-13`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-SEC-01_SecOC_SwReq.md#swr-sec-01-13), [`SWR-SEC-01-14`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-SEC-01_SecOC_SwReq.md#swr-sec-01-14)

##### `SYS-SEC-01-08`: Hardware Security Module (HSM) Cryptographic Key Storage & Secure Boot Interlock [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Secure cryptographic root keys in tamper-proof HSM silicon; execute secure boot chain of trust.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-SEC-01-15`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-SEC-01_SecOC_SwReq.md#swr-sec-01-15), [`SWR-SEC-01-16`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-SEC-01_SecOC_SwReq.md#swr-sec-01-16)

##### `SYS-SEC-01-09`: Controller Area Network Intrusion Detection System (CAN-IDS) Rate Anomaly Detector [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Detect bus flooding attacks, frame frequency anomalies, and spoofed diagnostic requests on CAN buses.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 5 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-SEC-01-17`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-SEC-01_SecOC_SwReq.md#swr-sec-01-17), [`SWR-SEC-01-18`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-SEC-01_SecOC_SwReq.md#swr-sec-01-18)

##### `SYS-SEC-01-10`: Automotive Ethernet IEEE 802.1Q MACsec Hardware Encryption Layer [ASIL B] [Release: R400]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Encrypt inter-domain Ethernet communications at wire speed (100/1000BASE-T1) using MACsec GCM-AES.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 2 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-SEC-01-19`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-SEC-01_SecOC_SwReq.md#swr-sec-01-19), [`SWR-SEC-01-20`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-SEC-01_SecOC_SwReq.md#swr-sec-01-20)

##### `SYS-SEC-01-11`: Diagnostic Service UDS $27 SecurityAccess 256-Bit Challenge-Response Engine [ASIL B] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Generate cryptographic pseudo-random seed and authenticate workshop tool response before unlock.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-SEC-01-21`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-SEC-01_SecOC_SwReq.md#swr-sec-01-21), [`SWR-SEC-01-22`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-SEC-01_SecOC_SwReq.md#swr-sec-01-22)

### FEAT-DIA-01: Unified Diagnostic Services & OBD-II Fault Management (UDS)
- **Domain:** Connectivity, Security & Diagnostics | **Target ASIL:** ASIL B / QM
- **Dedicated System Specification:** [`FEAT-DIA-01_UDS_SysReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/system_requirements/FEAT-DIA-01_UDS_SysReq.md)
- **Dedicated Software Specification:** [`FEAT-DIA-01_UDS_SwReq.md`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-DIA-01_UDS_SwReq.md)
- **Description:** Implements ISO 14229-1 UDS diagnostic server, Diagnostic over IP (DoIP ISO 13400), Diagnostic Trouble Code (DTC) debouncing, freeze frame serialization, and OBD-II compliance.
- **Activation Logic:** 12V system active, diagnostic stack initialized. Entry: Diagnostic tester connects via OBD port (CAN-FD) or Ethernet RJ45 (DoIP), sending valid UDS request.. Deactivation: Tester disconnects, S3 timeout (5000 ms) expires, or ignition powered down.. Override: Diagnostic Routine Control (Service 0x31) can command component test overrides only when vehicle speed == 0 km/h..
- **Safety Concept:** Goal: SG-DIA-01: Accurately record safety-critical system faults; prevent unauthorized diagnostic routine execution while driving. | FTTI: N/A | Safe State: Reject actuator override requests (NRC 0x22: ConditionsNotCorrect) if vehicle is in motion..

#### System Requirements (FEAT-DIA-01)

##### `SYS-DIA-01-01`: ISO 14229-1 UDS Diagnostic Services & DoIP Session Server [QM] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL support UDS services: 0x10, 0x11, 0x14, 0x19, 0x22, 0x2E, 0x27, 0x28, 0x2F, 0x31 over DoIP (ISO 13400) and CAN-FD, conforming to response time P2_server <= 50 ms and P2*_server <= 5000 ms.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: N/A | Safe State: Return Negative Response Code (NRC 0x10 / 0x22 / 0x33).
- **Failure Reaction:** If requested service is disallowed in current session, return NRC 0x7F (ServiceNotSupportedInActiveSession).
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-DIA-01-01`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-DIA-01_UDS_SwReq.md#swr-dia-01-01), [`SWR-DIA-01-02`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-DIA-01_UDS_SwReq.md#swr-dia-01-02)

##### `SYS-DIA-01-02`: DTC Fault Qualification, Freeze Frame Persistence & MIL Management [ASIL B] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL qualify faults as confirmed when persistent for >= 500 ms, record associated freeze frame environment variables into non-volatile memory, and illuminate the Malfunction Indicator Lamp (MIL) within <= 1.0 second.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 500 ms | Safe State: Persist fault record into redundant EEPROM sector.
- **Failure Reaction:** If EEPROM sector fails, write to secondary non-volatile flash partition.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-DIA-01-03`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-DIA-01_UDS_SwReq.md#swr-dia-01-03), [`SWR-DIA-01-04`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-DIA-01_UDS_SwReq.md#swr-dia-01-04)

##### `SYS-DIA-01-03`: 49 CFR Part 563 Crash Event Data Recorder (EDR) Blackbox Buffer [ASIL D / 49 CFR Part 563] [Release: R100]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL continuously record vehicle dynamic parameters at 100 Hz into circular FIFO RAM: Upon crash trigger (airbag deploy or delta-V > 8 km/h), system SHALL freeze and lock 5.0 seconds pre-crash and 300 ms post-crash telemetry into tamper-proof non-volatile flash memory.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Lock EDR flash memory against overwrite; preserve crash record across power loss.
- **Failure Reaction:** If flash write errors occur, write to redundant secondary EEPROM chip.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-DIA-01-05`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-DIA-01_UDS_SwReq.md#swr-dia-01-05), [`SWR-DIA-01-06`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-DIA-01_UDS_SwReq.md#swr-dia-01-06)

##### `SYS-DIA-01-04`: UDS ISO 14229 Service 0x27 Security Access Cryptographic Seed-Key [ISO 21434 / ASIL B] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL protect sensitive diagnostic services (flashing, variant coding, actuator override) using UDS Service 0x27 Security Access: Generating 32-byte cryptographically random seed and validating HMAC-SHA256 key response with anti-brute-force delay lockout (10s delay after 3 failed attempts).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: N/A | Safe State: Reject diagnostic command; lock security access level.
- **Failure Reaction:** If invalid key is supplied, increment failed attempt counter and enforce exponential time penalty.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-DIA-01-07`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-DIA-01_UDS_SwReq.md#swr-dia-01-07), [`SWR-DIA-01-08`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-DIA-01_UDS_SwReq.md#swr-dia-01-08)

##### `SYS-DIA-01-05`: ISO 14229 Unified Diagnostic Services (UDS) Multi-Client Protocol Server [ASIL B] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Execute UDS services ($10 DiagnosticSessionControl, $22 ReadDataByIdentifier, $2E WriteDataById).
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-DIA-01-09`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-DIA-01_UDS_SwReq.md#swr-dia-01-09), [`SWR-DIA-01-10`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-DIA-01_UDS_SwReq.md#swr-dia-01-10)

##### `SYS-DIA-01-06`: Diagnostic Trouble Code (DTC) 3-Byte Standard Fault Status Byte State Machine [ASIL B] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Manage 8-bit status byte (TestFailed, ConfirmedDTC, PendingDTC) per ISO 14229 Service $19.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-DIA-01-11`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-DIA-01_UDS_SwReq.md#swr-dia-01-11), [`SWR-DIA-01-12`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-DIA-01_UDS_SwReq.md#swr-dia-01-12)

##### `SYS-DIA-01-07`: Fault Debounce Pre-Failed / Pre-Passed Counter-Based & Time-Based Filter [ASIL B] [Release: R300]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Debounce fault signals (counter threshold 10, pre-failed step +2, pre-passed step -1) to prevent false trips.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 10 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-DIA-01-13`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-DIA-01_UDS_SwReq.md#swr-dia-01-13), [`SWR-DIA-01-14`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-DIA-01_UDS_SwReq.md#swr-dia-01-14)

##### `SYS-DIA-01-08`: Diagnostic Freeze-Frame Snapshot Buffer Non-Volatile Memory Serializer [ASIL B] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Capture and commit 64-byte freeze frame (speed, voltage, temperature, time) to EEPROM upon fault confirmation.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 50 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
- **Partitioned Child Software Requirements (1:N):** [`SWR-DIA-01-15`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-DIA-01_UDS_SwReq.md#swr-dia-01-15), [`SWR-DIA-01-16`](file:///c:/Workset/AntiGravityProjects/TestOptimisationExperiement/software_requirements/FEAT-DIA-01_UDS_SwReq.md#swr-dia-01-16)

##### `SYS-DIA-01-09`: OBD-II California Air Resources Board (CARB) Readiness Monitor Evaluator [ASIL B] [Release: R500]
- **Statement:** The System SHALL Track completion of regulatory OBD-II drive cycle readiness monitors across catalytic, EVAP, and misfire.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.

- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 20 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.

- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.

- **Statement:** The System SHALL Erase confirmed fault codes and freeze-frame buffers from flash upon authorized service command.
- **Activation & Safety:** FTTI: 100 ms | Safe State: Transition to safe state or safe degradation tier within FTTI budget.
- **Failure Reaction:** Isolate faulted channel, latch DEM diagnostic trouble code, and inform driver.
